### [286] [SeGDeP: Semantic- and Geometric-Aware Decoupled Prompts for Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08867)
*Linnan Zhao,Xu Liu,Lingling Li,Licheng Jiao,Fang Liu,Wenping Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本论文提出了SeGDeP，一种将语义（what）与空间位置（where）明确分离的多模态大模型（MLLM）分割接口，大幅提升了推理分割的性能和解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM分割方法要么依赖特殊触发指令，要么将语义与空间信号合并处理，导致监督混淆，难以诊断失败原因。需要一种明确分离语义识别和空间定位的方案，以更好理解和优化多模态推理分割。

Method: SeGDeP分别设立语义提示分支和几何投影路径，将MLLM中解析出的状态分别映射到语义特征和DETR预测的box，两者共同作为条件输入SAM 3的mask解码器。训练阶段首先对齐该可执行接口，再用GDPO（分组奖励-解耦策略优化）平衡输出格式、box-IoU和mask-IoU等指标。仅适配0.38%的Qwen3-VL参数（通过LoRA），实现高效端到端训练。

Result: SeGDeP-4B在8个RefCOCO系列任务上获得了82.7的平均cIoU，在ReasonSeg数据集的验证和测试集上分别取得了66.0和59.6的gIoU。分阶段消融实验和梯度诊断显示语义、几何两分支确实发展出互补的专长。

Conclusion: SeGDeP有效解耦了语义识别和空间定位，提升了分割性能和模型可解释性，同时保持参数高效，验证了多路径明确分工的优势。

Abstract: Reasoning segmentation converts an implicit linguistic conclusion into a precise mask, requiring both semantic identification and spatial grounding. Existing MLLM-segmenter interfaces either use a special trigger or compress both signals into one context, although they receive different supervision and fail differently. This coupling obscures whether a failure arises from target interpretation or from localization. We present SeGDeP, an explicit what-where interface. A semantic prompt branch and an independent geometric projection path transform resolved MLLM states into semantic features and a DETR-predicted box, which jointly condition a SAM 3 mask decoder. Training first aligns this executable interface, then uses group reward-decoupled policy optimization (GDPO) to balance format, box-IoU, and mask-IoU feedback. SeGDeP-4B reaches 82.7 average cIoU over eight RefCOCO-family splits and 66.0/59.6 gIoU on ReasonSeg val/test while adapting only 0.38% of Qwen3-VL parameters through LoRA. Controlled stage-wise ablations, gradient diagnostics, and prompt interventions further show that the two paths develop complementary semantic and geometric specialization rather than duplicating the same evidence.

</details>


### [287] [Medical AI Encodes a "Feeling of Error": Verifying Cancer Segmentation via Internal Concepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08879)
*Mengmeng Ma,Yunxiang Peng,Tang Li,Lu Lin,Binsheng Zhao,Oguz Akin,Xi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出通过分析模型内部激活信号，以检测肿瘤分割模型的失误，更好地预测模型何时会出错，并解释其原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的分割模型在出现错误时，往往未能及时预警，且现有基于输出不确定性的失败检测方式，难以解释错误发生的原因，同时敏感性与分割质量间存在权衡。亟需更有效且具解释力的方法来识别和预测模型失败，以提升医学AI的安全性和信任度。

Method: 借鉴人类“错误感知”机制，作者采用机械可解释性工具（如稀疏自编码器）分解模型内部神经激活，将其表示为可解释的概念字典。通过分析这些激活概念，发现失败样本激活的概念更少且激活幅度较低，并训练分类器据此判断模型是否犯错，同时给出错误解释。

Result: 在前列腺癌、胰腺癌及脑肿瘤分割任务上，该方法优于基于输出信号的方法，可准确检测失败且不损害分割结果质量。

Conclusion: 通过内部激活信号的分析，可实现高效、可解释的分割模型失败检测，为医学AI模型的安全应用提供了新工具。

Abstract: Cancer segmentation models can fail silently, generating plausible but incorrect masks that risk missed findings or unnecessary biopsies. A critical question arises: Do AI models "know" when they are wrong, and if so, can we use the signal to predict their own failures? Humans do have a "Feeling of Error" (FOE): a spontaneous sense of unease that flags a potential error during thinking. We investigate whether cancer segmentation models exhibit an analogous internal signal. Unlike output-level cues (e.g., prediction confidence or uncertainty), which offer no insight into why a failure occurs and suffer from a sensitivity-quality tradeoff where high detection sensitivity could degrade overall segmentation quality. We instead propose to capture the model's FOE from its inner workings. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, specifically Sparse Autoencoders, we decompose internal neural activations into a dictionary of human-interpretable concepts and show that failure cases exhibit a distinct latent signature: fewer active concepts with lower activation magnitudes compared to successful segmentation. By training a classifier on these concept activations, we achieve accurate failure detection along with explanations for the model's mistakes. Experiments on prostate, pancreatic, and brain cancer segmentation demonstrate that our approach outperforms output-based methods in failure detection while preserving segmentation quality.

</details>


### [288] [CoSA: Correlation-Guided Change A ttention with Learnable Residual Gating for Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08914)
*Abdirashid Omar,Jonghyuk Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文聚焦于在交通监控摄像头（CCTV）图像上高效训练人行横道检测模型，通过少量手工标注和大量无标注样本，实现较高精度，且强调伪标签评价的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定交通摄像头图像像素级标注昂贵，而直接用街景数据训练的模型在摄像头视角迁移时效果大幅下降，因此亟需针对目标域（即CCTV影像）设计高效低标注成本的训练流程。

Method: 1. 用241张人工标注的CCTV图像和5926张无标注CCTV帧，构建目标域训练管线；2. 源域实验用自定义U-Net在街景图像上训练，取得本地基线性能；3. CCTV域采用DeepLabV3-ResNet50模型，用201张人工标注做训练，40张做验证，再利用模型预测所有无标注帧，并通过图像置信度和最大连通组件排序筛选出1000个高置信伪标签样本。

Result: CCTV域人工标注数据集上获得88.91%的IoU验证分数。伪标签阶段的98.52%分数实际仅代表模型与自己生成标签的一致性，并非真实人工标注精度。推理速度为每张图像12.98毫秒，约77.03 FPS。

Conclusion: 该工作通过结合少量人工标注和高置信度伪标签，实现了在CCTV交通场景下高效、实用的人行横道检测。结果也揭示了伪标签评估不能与训练自用标签混用的重要性。

Abstract: Pixel-level annotation of fixed traffic-camera imagery is expensive, while crosswalk models trained from street-level imagery face a substantial viewpoint and appearance shift when applied to elevated CCTV. We investigate a data-efficient target-domain pipeline using 241 manually annotated CCTV images and 5,926 unlabeled CCTV frames. A source-domain experiment trains a 31.0M-parameter custom U-Net on 3,300 first-person-view (FPV) images and obtains 93.05% IoU on its 330-image FPV test split. This result is a source baseline, not transferred performance: the released CCTV notebook instantiates a 42.0M-parameter DeepLabV3-ResNet50 from torchvision weights, and no compatible mapping from the U-Net checkpoint is implemented. Training on 201 manual CCTV images and selecting on 40 held-out manual masks yields 88.91% IoU. The model then predicts all unlabeled frames; image-level certainty and a largest-component area prior rank the candidates, and the top 1,000 attain mean certainty 0.976 and mean combined score 0.988. A repository audit shows that the reported second-stage 98.52% IoU was measured on a 150-image split containing only teacher-generated pseudo-masks. Because of a directory-layout mismatch, the executed combined-data loader found zero manual samples and split 1,000 pseudo-labeled samples into 850 training and 150 evaluation samples. We therefore report 98.52% as internal pseudo-label agreement rather than human-ground-truth accuracy. The defensible target-domain result is 88.91% IoU on the 40 manual validation images. Batch-one FP32 inference at 512 x 512 requires 12.98 ms, corresponding to 77.03 FPS, on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 48 GB GPU. These findings support the practicality of confidence-and-geometry filtering while also showing why pseudo-label evaluation must remain isolated from the labels used for self-training.

</details>


### [289] [EgoSIS: From Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions to Motion-Canonical Spatial Evidence for UAV Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08938)
*Jingpu Yang,Fengxian Ji,Mingxuan Cui,Yilin Sun,Hang Zhang,Jianhua Zhu,Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoSIS是一种无需位姿信息的适配器，将RGB图像的双向光流转化为场景运动的标准视觉证据，并显著提升了无人机视频问答中的感知与记忆能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机视频问答模型很难区分摄像头的运动与场景内容的变化，且依赖于RGB信息的多模态模型缺乏一个稳定、明确的运动参考。

Method: 提出EgoSIS框架，包括三个阶段：（1）FVET对图像平面转变进行因子分解，提取运动、残差支持和可靠性因子；（2）ReTEM按可靠性加权更新历史并在关键帧或持续不确定时重新定位参考基点；（3）EASE将特征对齐到各自的本地锚点，通过零初始化的残差加入空间证据token，且不增加视觉token总数。

Result: 在SIS-Bench评测上，EgoSIS-8B分别取得了89.9%的感知、82.5%的感知+记忆和76.2%的整体准确率，表现出对自我感知和记忆有明显提升。

Conclusion: EgoSIS为光流与空间推理之间搭建了可解释的适配接口，有效提升了无人机视频问答在运动分离与场景理解方面的能力。

Abstract: UAV video question answering requires separating camera motion from changes in the scene, but RGB-only multimodal models receive no explicit, stable reference for that separation. We present EgoSIS, a pose-free adapter that converts RGB-derived bidirectional flow into motion-canonical visual evidence in three stages. Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions (FVET) fits a robust image-plane transition and exposes motion, residual-support, and reliability factors. Reliability-Gated Ego-Transition Memory (ReTEM) uses reliability-weighted updates for a bounded history and re-anchors it at cuts or sustained uncertainty. Ego-Aligned Spatial Evidence (EASE) warps supported visual features into each segment's local anchor and injects four spatial evidence tokens per visual slice through zero-initialized residuals, without changing Qwen's visual-token count. On SIS-Bench, EgoSIS-8B obtains 89.9\% perception, 82.5\% perception-plus-memory, and 76.2\% overall accuracy, with the largest gains concentrated in self-awareness perception and memory. The adapter thus provides an interpretable interface between optical flow and spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [290] [Prior-free relative 6D pose estimation of multiple object instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08949)
*Behdad Khodabandehloo,Andrea Caraffa,Davide Boscaini,Fabio Poiesi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全新的6D姿态估计算法PROSE，无需任何对象先验信息和训练，通过多模态基础特征和循环一致性，实现了对同一图像内多个未知对象实例间的相对6D姿态估计。还构建了匹配新任务的评测基准PRENCH。方法无需监督，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统6D姿态估计大多依赖于特定对象的3D模型、参考图片等先验信息，限制了算法的通用性和实际应用范围。本文动机在于探索无需任何对象先验（模板、CAD模型、参考图像）的6D姿态估计，提升姿态估计在未知对象场景中的能力。

Method: 提出无先验相对6D姿态估计设定。算法（PROSE）首先利用多模态基础特征在同一图像内不同实例之间建立粗略对应关系，然后通过施加循环一致性进行细化，最后利用全局一致的对应关系推算出任意实例对之间的相对6D姿态。整个方法不需要训练，也无须对象先验信息。

Result: 作者基于三个人工合成BOP数据集构建了一个新的多实例评测基准PRENCH，并在其上系统评估了PROSE。与最先进的单图像姿态方法适配到新任务后的基线方法相比，PROSE在多个评价指标上表现更优，且无需任务特定监督或额外学习组件。

Conclusion: 本工作首次实现了无需对象先验、训练及监督的相对6D姿态估计任务，并提出了相应的无监督算法和新基准，推动了相关领域的发展。

Abstract: Object 6D pose estimation formulations have progressively reduced reliance on object-specific priors, evolving from explicit 3D models to multi-view object captures to single reference images. We take this progression to its extreme by introducing prior-free relative 6D pose estimation, which lifts the assumption of knowing which object is to be posed within the scene. This novel setting aims to estimate the relative poses of multiple instances of an unknown object within the same image, without requiring CAD models, templates, or reference images. We solve this by formulating a novel method (PROSE) that finds coarse correspondences between object instances using multimodal foundation features, thus requiring no training. We refine these correspondences by imposing cycle consistency across tuples of instances, and leverage the resulting globally consistent correspondences to estimate the relative 6D pose between any pair of instances. To enable systematic evaluation, we design a novel benchmark (PRENCH) built from three multi-instance BOP datasets and enriched with task-specific metadata. PROSE consistently outperforms baselines obtained by adapting state-of-the-art single-image methods to the proposed setting, while requiring neither task-specific supervision nor additional learned components. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/PROSE/

</details>


### [291] [Concentrate After Imagination: Text-Conditioned Evidence Grounding for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08999)
*Shuaiqi Cheng,Siyu You,Yanbi Wu,Yuxi Chen,Jiahao Zhang,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对部分相关视频检索（PRVR）中“查询无关的分数集中瓶颈”提出了TRACE算子，通过查询条件驱动的证据校准提升检索准确性，在多个数据集上刷新了基线模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PRVR方法在面对查询仅描述视频片段的情况下，往往依赖于最强的局部响应，容易被偶然相似片段误导，导致检索排名失真。作者识别到这是由于视频响应“查询不可知的分数集中瓶颈”造成的。

Method: 提出了一种新颖的分数级证据校验算子TRACE。该方法先找出全局视频表示中与查询相关的部分，激活相关寄存器，再将其支持度传递到帧级证据，并对各种路径进行平滑边际化。TRACE方式与传统特征融合不同，是在局部打分基础上叠加一个依赖于查询的残差校准。

Result: 在ActivityNet Captions、Charades-STA和TVR三大基准数据集上，TRACE分别为SumR提升了1.2、1.1和1.5，均刷新了DreamPRVR骨干框架的表现。消融、路径扰动、困难负例和跨模型测试均表明性能提升源于针对查询的证据校验，而非泛化性分数偏移。

Conclusion: TRACE有效解决了PRVR中查询不可知分数集中瓶颈，显著提升了检索精度，是一种高效、实用的分数级证据校验新操作。

Abstract: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) retrieves untrimmed videos when queries describe only short moments. Although recent methods improve local representations, uncertainty modeling, and global context, final ranking often still trusts the strongest local response; a coincidentally similar fragment can therefore produce an unsupported peak. We identify this failure as the query-agnostic concentration bottleneck and propose TRACE, a score-level evidence verification operator for PRVR. Given a query and global video registers, TRACE activates query-relevant registers, routes their support to frame-level evidence, and smoothly marginalizes alternative query-to-register-to-frame paths before localized temporal selection. Unlike representation-level feature fusion, TRACE uses this evidence only as a query-conditioned residual calibration of the original local score. On ActivityNet Captions, Charades-STA, and TVR, TRACE achieves the best SumR on all three benchmarks and improves the DreamPRVR backbone by 1.2, 1.1, and 1.5 points, respectively. Ablation, routing-corruption, hard-negative, and cross-backbone transfer analyses support the interpretation that the gains arise from query-conditioned evidence verification rather than a generic score offset.

</details>


### [292] [DXPR: Depth-Based Vision-LiDAR Cross-Modal Place Recognition Using Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09005)
*Yungsoo Han,Youngseok Jang,Seungwon Roh,Jeongyeon Seo,H. Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种称为DXPR的跨模态地点识别框架，可用单目相机在预建的激光雷达地图下，实现鲁棒定位，无需针对不同模态分别设计编码器。核心方法是把相机图像和激光雷达扫描统一为深度图像，再用同一视觉基础模型进行特征提取。通过几何感知交集挖掘算法提升学习效率，并大幅优化跨季节、气候及昼夜变化下的识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器人和自动驾驶车辆需要在不同模态（如相机和激光雷达）之间进行鲁棒的地点识别，但现有方法要么依赖多模态编码器，要么在极端环境变化下识别效果差。因此，开发无需模态专用编码器、对环境变化有更强鲁棒性的CMPR方法有重要意义。

Method: 1. 将相机和激光雷达数据统一转换为深度图像。2. 利用视觉基础模型作为统一特征提取骨干网络，再加聚合头学习模态无关的全局描述子。3. 提出几何感知重叠度挖掘方法，通过前向投影获得像素层面的重叠分数，用于重新标注匹配对并自适应调整损失函数，以避免弱重叠样本过拟合。4. 在KITTI和Boreas数据集上进行丰富实验。

Result: 在KITTI数据集多数测试序列上DXPR Recall@1接近100%，显著优于以往跨模态方法。在Boreas数据集上，DXPR在更具挑战性的跨序列测试下比单模态和已有跨模态方法表现更优秀。无论在季节、天气还是昼夜变化下均表现出极强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DXPR提出了无需模态专属编码器的跨模态地点识别新范式，通过深度统一表示和几何感知训练方法，实现了在复杂环境变化下更加鲁棒和高效的跨模态识别能力，为机器人和自动驾驶在实际环境中的应用提供了更可行的技术路线。

Abstract: We present DXPR, a depth-based cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) framework that uses vision foundation models (VFMs) to match monocular camera queries against a LiDAR map without modality-specific encoders. This enables robots and autonomous vehicles to robustly localize using only cameras within pre-built LiDAR maps, even under severe seasonal, weather, and illumination changes. The key idea is to convert both camera images and LiDAR scans into a unified depth image representation so that a single VFM backbone with an aggregation head can learn modality-invariant global descriptors. To make pairwise metric learning faithful to scene geometry, we introduce a geometry-aware overlap miner: after cross-modal scale alignment of camera and LiDAR depth, we forward-warp measurements between views to compute a pixel-level overlap score. This score relabels ambiguous pairs and adaptively modulates the positive margin in a multi-similarity loss to avoid overfitting on weakly overlapping views. Extensive experiments on KITTI odometry and Boreas demonstrate strong performance and robustness across seasons, weather, and day/night. On KITTI, DXPR achieves near-perfect Recall@1 on most sequences and outperforms prior CMPR baselines. On Boreas, DXPR achieves intra-sequence performance on par with a strong single-modal baseline (DINOv2-SALAD), while showing clear improvements in the more challenging inter-sequence setting. Compared with RangeBEV, our method consistently performs better in both intra- and inter-sequence evaluations, demonstrating robustness under diverse seasonal and illumination changes.

</details>


### [293] [A Joint 2D-3D Statistical Shape Model for Orthopedic Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09010)
*Florence Dell'Aniello Picard,Pranav Poudel,Nairouz Shehata,Frédéric Lavoie,Herve Lombaert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合二维与三维统计形状模型（SSM）的股骨三维重建方法，比传统三维SSM方法更高效、更精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统通过X射线进行三维股骨重建面临深度信息丢失的问题。现有方法依赖于3D SSM并进行繁琐的迭代配准，效率低且未充分挖掘二维与三维之间的统计关系。

Method: 提出联合二维与三维SSM，将2D与3D分割配准到标准三维模板及其2D投影，通过PCA联合分解这两者的统计共变关系。训练后，将未见过的2D分割的低维潜在向量直接映射到3D子空间，实现无迭代的3D重建。

Result: 在NMDID数据集上的实验证明，本方法的重建精度优于传统3D SSM基线，同时推理速度提升4倍，每个样本低于3秒。

Conclusion: 联合2D-3D SSM能更快更准地从X射线恢复股骨三维形状，具备临床应用潜力。

Abstract: Three-dimensional femoral reconstruction from radiographs supports surgical planning, implant sizing, and post-operative follow-up, but remains ill-posed as X-ray projections discard depth information. Existing methods often incorporate a 3D statistical shape model (SSM) as a shape prior to guide reconstructions toward anatomically plausible shapes, relying on iterative 3D-to-2D projection matching. Yet, these approaches are computationally expensive and constrain their SSM to a single dimensionality, leaving the statistical relationship between 2D observations and 3D geometry largely unexploited and unexplored. We instead propose a joint 2D-3D SSM that explicitly captures the co-variation between 2D and 3D segmentations in a shared latent space. During training, 2D and 3D segmentations are registered to a common 3D template and its corresponding 2D projections, and the resulting stationary velocity fields are jointly decomposed using principal component analysis (PCA). This joint modeling allows the 2D-to-3D mapping to be learned directly from data rather than computing correspondences at inference time. For unseen subjects, the 3D shape is recovered directly by lifting the 2D latent coordinates to the 3D PCA subspace, thereby eliminating the need for iterative 3D-to-2D projection. Experiments on NMDID demonstrate that the proposed joint 2D-3D SSM outperforms a widely-used 3D-only SSM baseline while achieving inference approximately 4 times faster, at under 3 seconds per subject. The code is available at: https://github.com/florence-dellaniello-picard/joint2d3d-ssm.

</details>


### [294] [PIC: Revisiting INR for Image Coding with Fast Encoding and Sub-Millisecond Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09020)
*Xiang Liu,Jinxiang Wang,Bin Chen,Zimo Liu,Mingyao Hong,Jiawei Li,Yaowei Wang,Shu-tao Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种实用的隐式神经表示（INR）图像编解码器（PIC），在保持压缩性能的同时，大幅提升了编码和解码速度，是第一个在速率-失真性能和解码速度上均优于JPEG且编码速度实用的学习型图像编解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前INR图像压缩技术虽在解码复杂度上有显著优势，但存在编码速度慢和解码效率没有充分利用的问题，因此难以实际应用。

Method: 作者提出了一种前馈式INR编码架构PIC，仅需一次前向传播就能获得网络所有所需信息，显著提升编码速度。同时开发了高度优化的解码器，提升了解码速率。

Result: PIC编码速度可达20帧每秒，解码速度高达2000帧每秒，并且在速率-失真性能上达到或优于JPEG。

Conclusion: PIC在保持良好压缩质量的同时，极大提升了编码和解码的实际效率，为INR在实际图像编解码中的应用提供了可能性。

Abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis and image/video coding in recent years.Compared to conventional end-to-end image codecs, INR-based compressors demonstrate significant advantages in decoding complexity. However, their practical application has been hindered by the inferior encoding speed and underutilized decoding efficiency.In this work, we propose a feedforward INR image coding architecture, Practical INR Image Codec (PIC), that computes all the necessary information for INR network in a single forward pass, achieving an encoding speed of 20 FPS. Additionally, we implement a highly optimized decoder that reaches 2000 FPS decoding speed, significantly surpassing JPEG's performance at comparable rate-distortion (RD) performance. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first learning-based image codec that simultaneously outperforms or is comparable with JPEG in both RD performance and decoding speed while maintaining practical encoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC.

</details>


### [295] [Task-driven Processing with Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09025)
*Oleh Kolner,Thomas Ortner,Stanisław Woźniak,Angeliki Pantazi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新方法CF-GAP，通过模拟任务驱动的视线转移，有效提升了实例检测模型在高分辨率及复杂场景下的检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前主流视觉模型需要处理整幅图像，缺乏对关键信息的聚焦能力，导致在高分辨率、复杂背景下目标易丢失，尤其在实例检测等需要定位具体物体的任务中影响更明显。

Method: 提出了Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception（CF-GAP）前端模块。CF-GAP根据任务信息，主动选择一系列局部视域，在这些区域进行高分辨率细致分析，而无需全图处理，再将选中区域输入到下游实例检测器。这样可避免无关信息干扰及压缩损失。

Result: 在HR-InsDet和Robotools基准上，CF-GAP为多种主流实例检测器带来最高可达20%的平均精度（AP）提升，使得小型检测器性能甚至超越大体量模型。

Conclusion: CF-GAP显著提升了实例检测的精准度和效率，实现了有针对性的高分辨率处理，为轻量级模型在复杂任务中超越大型模型提供了新途径。

Abstract: State-of-the-art vision models process images in their entirety, lacking the ability to selectively zoom in on relevant regions. This limitation is particularly acute in scenarios where processing must be conditioned on a specific task - such as instance detection, which requires localizing a specific object in a high-resolution, cluttered scene. In such settings, critical details are easily lost as images are often resized to match the model dimensions and computational constraints. We introduce Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception (CF-GAP), a task-driven front-end that enhances high-resolution processing of existing instance detectors. CF-GAP selectively directs a sequence of limited view glimpses across the scene, utilizing task information to iteratively refine focus on the most relevant regions. These localized regions are then processed at high resolution by a downstream instance detector. By avoiding full-image processing and eliminating irrelevant confounding information, CF-GAP improves Average Precision (AP) by up to 20% across various state-of-the-art instance detectors on the HR-InsDet and Robotools benchmarks, while further enabling lightweight detectors to outperform their larger counterparts.

</details>


### [296] ["World Knowledge" in the Weights: Reading Concept Circuits of Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09055)
*Yanlin Chen,Tang Li,Xi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) 从视觉Transformer (ViT) 中提取解释性概念电路的方法，从而理解其内部结构信息，并利用这些电路发现和修正伪相关、对比不同模型的表征结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT通用性强但内部表征如何反映世界结构鲜有人知。作者希望开发技术揭开ViT表征机制，提升模型可解释性，并应用于实际的伪相关检测与修正。

Method: 本方法利用CLT从ViT学习参数中提取概念电路，这种电路将神经元激活与语义概念对应，并通过节点和边刻画各层之间的概念交互。包括全局（输入无关）和实例级（输入相关）两种电路表征，分别揭示模型编码的世界知识和具体推理过程。作者基于此进行伪相关自动发现和干预、不同模型对比分析等实验。

Result: 基于Waterbird数据集，实例电路干预实现了比现有方法高出11.0%的伪相关修正准确率。此外，通过对比CLIP与DINO等不同基础模型的全局概念电路，揭示了不同监督范式对表征结构的影响。

Conclusion: 提出的概念电路方法有效增强了ViT的可解释性，支持了更可靠的模型诊断与修正手段，在模型比较和透明化方面具有实际应用价值。代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) have achieved remarkable generalization across visual domains, yet little is known about how they internally represent the structure of the world. To address this gap, we use Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) to read concept circuits from ViTs: directed graphs whose nodes correspond to sparse, interpretable concepts and edges capture concept interactions across layers. Our method yields two complementary views of model behavior. The global concept circuit is input-invariant and can be recovered directly from learned cross-layer weights, exposing the reusable "world knowledge" encoded in the model. The instance concept circuit is input-dependent and identifies the concepts and pathways actually used for a specific prediction, enabling faithful example-level explanations. We demonstrate the utility of concept circuits in three ways: (1) Automatic spurious correlation discovery: leveraging the statistics of our global concept circuits to identify shortcut dependencies within the model. (2) Spurious correlation removal: intervening on the instance concept circuit to steer the model towards correct predictions. Empirical results show that our method outperforms existing counterparts by 11.0% on the Waterbird dataset. (3) Model comparison: contrasting the global concept circuits of different foundation models (e.g., CLIP vs. DINO) to reveal how supervision paradigms shape representational structure. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/VisionCLT

</details>


### [297] [GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09082)
*Thodoris Betsas,Anastasios Doulamis,Andreas Georgopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种全新open vocabulary的3D语义分割方法，无需3D训练数据或编码器，仅利用视觉-语言模型生成结构化文本描述，通过语言嵌入实现3D分割。方法在多个数据集上取得优异表现，尤其是在未见类别的分割与定位上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有open vocabulary的3D分割方法依赖于CLIP等视觉-语言空间，表现为bag-of-words，组合能力有限，且通常需要大量3D训练数据和单独的3D编码器，限制了泛化和适应性。

Method: 作者使用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）对每个角度的图片生成结构化、实体级别的描述，把这些描述投影到通用的语言嵌入空间。3D点的特征由文本描述聚合，无需任何3D训练数据或专属编码器，还提出加权和解释性增强的聚合策略，使结果更加精准且可解释。

Result: 在ScanNet++数据集上，与使用ScanNet训练的无注释baseline相比，作者的方法具备强竞争力。文化遗产5建筑基准测试中，通过词汇修正后方法优于基于CLIP的变体，并可对未见类别物体实现分割和定位，且分离在/不在场物体的能力更强。

Conclusion: 提出的GoDeep方法证明基于语言空间的3D语义嵌入，无需3D训练，可实现可解释、高保真的3D分割，尤其在泛化到未见类别和场景定位方面优于基于CLIP的传统方法。

Abstract: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. An effect confirmed by a second, independent correction on a different class, indicating that language-space embeddings track physical content more faithfully. This fidelity extends to genuinely out-of-vocabulary (OOV) objects on ScanNet++ proving that language-space embeddings separate presence from absence objects far more sharply than CLIP-based embeddings do. GoDeep also localize these OOV objects within the scene, all without any 2D-3D annotation. Because every representation remains discrete text, predictions are also explainable at the point level. Finally, exploiting both a heuristic weighting, that favors precise over merely frequent observations and GoDeep's explainability property, we propose an aggregation strategy, as a proof of concept, that favors finer elements localization.

</details>


### [298] [Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09123)
*Zhuoran Zhao,Shengju Qian,Tongtong Liang,Xianghao Kong,Songchun Zhang,Junchao Huang,Guian Fang,Xin Wang,Pan Hui,Anyi Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种创新的Mask Forcing方法，有效缓解了AR视频扩散模型蒸馏中因反向KL目标导致的模式崩溃和画质问题，显著提升了视频的视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AR视频扩散模型经过分布匹配蒸馏后，生成视频存在过饱和与过平滑问题，缺乏真实感。主要原因在于DMD蒸馏中的反向KL目标具有模式寻优倾向，导致学生模型分布仅覆盖教师分布有限的模式，出现模式崩溃。

Method: 提出Mask Forcing（双重噪声掩码展开）策略，在自回滚阶段沿空间和时间轴对输入施加随机掩码，干扰学生模型自回滚过程，通过混入干净信号，引导模型探索教师分布的更多区域。掩码不仅促进了探索，还为一些噪声较大的token提供去噪参考，有助于中间预测的修正，减少误差累积。

Result: 新方法无需额外数据或后处理阶段下，显著提升了多种AR视频扩散蒸馏方法的视觉效果和真实感，且效率较高。

Conclusion: Mask Forcing有效克服了传统DMD蒸馏中的模式崩溃与视觉质量瓶颈，为高质量AR视频生成提供了更优策略。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have shown great potential in real-time video generation. Recent methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into causal AR students through Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but the generated videos often suffer from over-saturation and over-smoothing issues, resulting in limited visual quality and realism. The key contributing factor is the mode-seeking behavior of the reverse KL objective in DMD, which can cause the student distribution to collapse onto only a few modes of the teacher distribution. To address this, we propose Mask Forcing, a Dual-Noise Masking Rollout strategy that perturbs the AR student self-rollout to mitigate mode collapse induced by reverse-KL mode seeking. The core idea is to inject cleaner signals into noisy rollout inputs via random masks along spatial and temporal axes during the self-rollout process of AR diffusion distillation. Such perturbations encourage the student rollouts to explore more regions of the teacher distribution, allowing DMD to provide learning signals beyond the modes already covered by the student. Moreover, the cleaner tokens act as denoising guidance for other noisier tokens, improving the intermediate rollout predictions and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method improves multiple AR video diffusion distillation methods with higher visual quality efficiently, without incorporating real video data or additional post-training stages.

</details>


### [299] [Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09124)
*Xiaofu Chen,Stella Frank,Yova Kementchedjhieva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉编码器在没有颜色输入时是否仍然能表达物体的典型颜色概念信息。通过创建标注了典型颜色的数据集，并分别用彩色和灰度图像对视觉编码器进行分析，发现即使在灰度图像下，编码器也能解码出物体的典型颜色。这说明视觉编码器中存在物体概念层面的信息。进一步地，后续的VLM训练对颜色可解码性影响显著。整体上，典型颜色是分析VLM中语义信息传递的有力工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管视觉-语言模型依靠视觉编码器获取图像表征，但尚不清楚这些表征中有多少属概念性语义信息（如物体的典型颜色），尤其是在输入图片不直接显示这些特征时。因此，作者希望通过研究“典型颜色”来揭示视觉编码器内部是否包含超越可见属性的概念信息。

Method: 作者构建了一个包含具有典型颜色的物体的数据集，对视觉编码器进行探测，分析在彩色和灰度图像输入下，编码器是否依然能解码出对象的典型颜色和类别。同时，将实验拓展到整个视觉-语言模型（VLM），研究模型后训练（post-training）对颜色可解码性的影响。

Result: 实验发现，即使输入图像为灰度，视觉编码器也能显著地解码出物体的典型颜色，这种可解码特性与对象身份的预测密切相关。进一步在VLM中，模型的后训练阶段会对视觉编码器中颜色可解码性的提升带来巨大影响。

Conclusion: 视觉编码器不仅仅表达表面可见特征，还隐含了物体层面的概念性语义信息，如典型颜色。典型颜色作为分析工具，有助于理解和追踪视觉-语言模型内部的概念信息表达方式。

Abstract: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision encoders and VLMs.

</details>


### [300] [Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09145)
*Minsik Jeon,Jay Karhade,Deva Ramanan,Shubham Tulsiani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Point4D，一种新的前馈模型，能在上百帧的长视频序列中，进行高质量4D（三维空间+时间）重建，预测每个点的三维轨迹，性能超过现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D重建方法只能处理几十帧以内的短视频，无法实现长时序、多帧的高效、高精度三维轨迹追踪。作者希望突破这一帧数限制，实现对数百帧长视频的稳定追踪和重建。

Method: 引入了基于3D查询的运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像可见性解耦，预测的三维端点直接用于下一段追踪，无需繁琐的重投影或匹配。还通过从任意可见帧提取视觉描述符并复用，提升了追踪性能。

Result: Point4D在多种超过200帧的长视频追踪基准测试中取得了SOTA（最先进）表现，显著优于先前的前馈4D方法。

Conclusion: Point4D成功解决了长视频4D重建和点轨迹追踪难题，在性能和适用范围上超越了现有方法，对大规模视频处理和重建具有重要意义。

Abstract: We introduce Point4D, a feed-forward model for 4D reconstruction of long-range video sequences. Point4D is able to reliably infer dense per-point 3D trajectories across multi-hundred-frame videos, unlike existing 4D methods that are limited to short input windows of at most a few dozen frames. A key innovation that enables this is our flexible 3D query-based motion decoder that decouples trajectory prediction from image-plane visibility. The predicted 3D endpoints are then directly re-queried in the next chunk without re-projection or matching. Furthermore, we show that extracting and reusing a visual descriptor from an arbitrary frame where the point is visible leads to better performance than relying solely on the source patch. Overall, Point4D achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-video tracking benchmarks spanning over 200 frames and largely outperforms previous feed-forward 4D method. Project page: https://point-4d.github.io

</details>


### [301] [SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09155)
*Yuncong Yang,Zhengtao Han,Furkan Ozyurt,Zeyuan Yang,Han Yang,Junyi Cao,Haoyu Zhen,Yilun Du,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的行动条件世界模型SyncWorld，能在未见环境下零样本模拟机器人的行动效果，无需额外训练。核心创新在于通过视觉校准过程来适应不同的环境和机器人设置，从而克服视觉像素空间中动作表征的不通用性，实现泛化和高精度模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统世界模型难以在机器人领域大规模应用，主要因为相同行动在不同视觉环境中表现不一致，导致训练监督冲突和泛化能力差。需要一种通用框架解决机器人的“动作-视觉”映射难题，实现在新环境下仍可高精度模拟。

Method: SyncWorld通过一次视觉校准实验（采集一组配对的帧和动作，覆盖可控自由度），获得特定环境/机器人的“动作-视觉映射”；训练时结合这些校准上下文，模型学会依据视觉证据解释它接收到的动作并利用交互历史。无需对新环境单独训练，只需校准即可泛化。

Result: 实验表明：SyncWorld可在从未见过的新环境中准确模拟动作结果，其基于高质量世界模型的“虚拟回滚”能力还使得测试时无需训练即可改进策略。

Conclusion: SyncWorld有效解决了机器人世界模型在视觉像素空间中的动作泛化难题，实现了跨环境零样本模拟及在线策略改进，为机器人智能快速适应新场景提供了有力工具。

Abstract: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [302] [When Agent Governance Helps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05531)
*Michael Ray Johnson,Linda Naimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一个针对自驱AI多智能体系统的治理框架，展示其在医疗场景下的应用，并揭示治理成效受模型剩余算力及领域影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前尚无权威规范指导如何设计和评估在治理约束下、能够自主设定目标的多智能体AI组织。针对这一问题，作者试图提出一套可执行框架并探索其在实际任务中的效果与边界。

Method: 1. 基于321份文献，综合多种理论（代理、敏捷、平台、治理）提出GAMPO框架，并给出可运行的规范文档。2. 将GAMPO以prompt层应用在CHI-Bench医疗任务基准上，分别在开源与前沿大模型上测试。3.对治理流程、不同任务定义及模型表现进行实验比较。

Result: （1）治理的效用受限于模型剩余算力，且结果与领域/模型相关。在开源模型上完整治理程序无效，仅一句简单核查语句可将成功率翻倍。在前沿模型上，治理流程可使成功率提升，但在部分模型上无效。（2）将标准从通用流程调整为按案例/标准定义可显著提升表现，如prior-authorization任务成功率提升到84%。

Conclusion: 本文贡献了一个具名且可审计的AI治理框架，首次提出治理应依模型剩余算力调整，并且对高阶模型来说，基于具体案例的标准优于一刀切流程。结果具有探索性，需进一步大样本和多轮实验验证。

Abstract: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.

</details>


### [303] [TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05631)
*Santhoshkumar V*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文推出了用于泰米尔语语音对话结束检测的数据集（TamilEOT）和模型，实现高效的用户发言终止点检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数语音代理系统仅凭静音时间判断用户是否说完，容易导致用户体验不佳，且现有开放语义检测模型未覆盖南印度语言。为泰米尔语等欠资源语言补足相关技术，有助于语音代理在更多语种下实现自然交互。

Method: 作者收集并标注了18,485个泰米尔语语音对话转接边界，来自116个真实电话对话。提出并细调两个音频端到端检测模型，在Smart Turn v3基础上做微调，并比较了不同标注及训练杠杆的影响。

Result: 在未见过的4,168个测试片段中，模型准确率从零样本的70.30%提升至83.71%和86.13%；ROC-AUC从0.751提升至0.921。两个模型均可在笔记本CPU单线程下150毫秒内推理。标注一致性分析显示，音频大模型标注与人工一致性高达97.5%。

Conclusion: 泰米尔语语音EOT检测数据与模型首次公开，为南印度语种语音代理奠定基础。核心提升来自模型容量，其他变量影响较小。所用数据、权重、代码和全部负结果向公众开放。

Abstract: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. Without a model of the language that decision falls back to a fixed silence timeout: set it short and the agent interrupts, set it long and every turn pays the full wait. Open semantic end-of-turn detectors exist, but to our knowledge none covers a South Indian language. We release TamilEOT: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries cut from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, and two audio-only detectors fine-tuned from Smart Turn v3. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both models run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. Rule-derived labels, checked against a blind human listening pass, were right 95.9% of the time on the positive class and 44.4% on the negative class, which is below chance, because the rule answered a different question than the model is asked. Replacing them with an audio-LLM labeller measured at 97.5% human agreement cost US$5.69. Of every training lever we measured, only encoder capacity moved the result; three runs at identical config and seed span 0.87 accuracy points, which is the floor below which none of our other deltas mean anything. Replaying the same labelled boundaries through the production VAD and streaming adapter costs a further 2.60 points, and 7.8% of boundaries are never surfaced to the model at all. Data, weights, code and every negative result are public.

</details>


### [304] [Better Together: Complementary Query Rewriting Under a Strong RAG Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05637)
*Sara Shanian,Xiaoqin Yi,Pavlo Ruban,Kurt MacDonald*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文测试了在已经很强的检索系统中，查询重写是否还能带来性能提升，发现单一重写方法提升有限，但多方法组合显著提升效果。建议将查询重写视为补充手段，并结合成本感知的智能路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG中查询重写被广泛用来提升检索效果，但尚不清楚在高性能基础系统下，重写还能否进一步提升，以及怎样利用查询重写性价比最高。

Method: 在固定高水准RAG流程（BGE稠密检索、交叉编码排序、MMR多样性）下，对四种查询重写方法与两个LLM基线法在三个数据集上进行对比实验（含显著性测试），并设计成本感知的智能路由策略。

Result: 单一查询重写和强基线相当，多法组合（如S1+S3+S4+HyDE）在企业数据上HIT@10提升12.5点，在HotpotQA提升1.6~1.8点，在AmbigNQ略有下降。智能路由实现半数增益，且只在部分低信心样本上触发重写。

Conclusion: 查询重写不是强基线的替代，应作为互补手段，配合动态路由智能适用，以提高增益和性价比。

Abstract: A popular way to improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is to rewrite the user's question into several variants and search with all of them. We test whether this actually helps once the underlying search is already strong. Under one fixed, competitive pipeline (BGE dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and MMR diversification), we compare four query-rewriting strategies (S1-S4) against two strong LLM baselines (HyDE, Query2Doc) on three datasets (HotpotQA, AmbigNQ, and the 512K-document EnterpriseRAG-Bench) over three seeds with paired-bootstrap significance tests. Our headline result is that rewriting alone is at best competitive with a strong baseline, but combining methods yields outsized gains because different strategies fail on different questions. A post-hoc union of four methods (S1+S3+S4+HyDE) improves HIT@10 over the baseline by +12.5 points on enterprise data (51.70 vs 39.22), and a five-method union reaches 52.98 (+13.8). Budget-matched controls capture only ~40% of this gain, confirming that complementarity, not retrieval budget, is the primary driver. On HotpotQA the union adds +1.6 to +1.8 points (p<0.001), saturating the all-method oracle; on AmbigNQ the same fusion hurts (-2.4 below the best solo, p<0.001), and we analyze when and why. Because rewriting is expensive, we evaluate in simulation a confidence-gated router that runs rewriting only when the baseline's own top-1 score is low. It captures about half of the enterprise full-merge gain (+4.3 HIT@10) while paying rewriting cost on <40% of queries, and automatically declines to rewrite on AmbigNQ. A downstream answer-quality evaluation confirms the router improves F1 by +1.92 (p<0.01) at roughly 40% of the expansion cost. In short: treat query rewriting as a complementary coverage source, applied through cost-aware routing, not as a standalone replacement for a strong baseline.

</details>


### [305] [Who Maintains Agent Skills? A Longitudinal Study of Human-Governed, AI-Assisted Skill Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05677)
*Chen Shen,Estevam Hruschka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了LLM智能体在持续生命周期中依赖于外部技能文件的维护与更新机制，发现当前的技能管理主要是人工主导，AI辅助，且技能编辑以内容新增和修正为主。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体能力积累和分布在不同外部技能文件中，如何有效维护、自动化编辑和提升技能文件的准确性和时效性成为关键挑战。

Method: 作者系统收集并分析了五个开源AI技能代码库的完整Git提交历史，对每一次实质性技能文件编辑通过预注册编码本进行治理、操作类型及触发证据标注，并统计人工与AI共同编辑的比例。

Result: （1）所有实质性技能编辑均由实名人工账号发起或合并，62%带有AI协作者签名，但不同库间差异显著；（2）编辑内容主要是对技能文件的新增和修正；（3）尝试用规则化维度对编辑分类，发现这一测量方法缺乏可靠性。

Conclusion: 目前AI技能文件的维护更像是以人为主、AI辅助的混合流程，完全自动化技能自维护尚未实现，后续自动化维护系统需以现有人类-人工AI协作机制为基准进行评估和改进。

Abstract: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly rely on external skill artifacts as one element for preserving and reusing capabilities over time. These skills (usually portable Markdown files such as SKILL.md) describe when and how to apply a capability and must be corrected, expanded, and consolidated as tools and usage patterns shift over deployment. Recent work seeks to automate skill curation, but it largely evaluates against automated baselines and treats human maintenance as an unmeasured bottleneck. We study that missing process directly. We mine the full commit histories of five public AI-skill repositories, a purposive sample of AI-tooling organizations, covering 873 commits, 143 skill files, and 254 substantive post-creation edits from October 2025 to June 2026. We code each edit with pre-registered governance, operation, and trigger-evidence codebooks. Three findings emerge. First, every substantive edit is authored or merged through a named human account, while 62% carry an AI co-author trailer, with large repository-level variation. Second, these edits are genuine curation: an audited sample shows that most change skill content, and the coded operations are dominated by additions and corrections. Third, a pre-registered rule-likeness axis fails its reliability gate; reliably coding rule-likeness from commit artifacts remains an open measurement problem. We release the corpus, codebooks, mining scripts, and a replay protocol for automated skill curators. For self-evolving agents, public skill maintenance currently looks less like an autonomous pipeline than a human-governed, AI-assisted loop that future curators must measure against and operate within.

</details>


### [306] [A Rubric-Guided Large Language Model Solution for Opioid Use Disorder Computable Phenotyping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05682)
*Mengxian Lyu,Paredes Pardo,Cheng Peng,Ziyi Chen,Mengyuan Zhang,Jieting Li Lu,Gary M Reisfield,William M Greene,Jenny Lo-Ciganic,Yonghui Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究利用基于专家打分表的提示优化（OPRO）大型语言模型（LLM），开发出一种自动提取证据用于识别阿片使用障碍（OUD）的电子健康记录（EHR）可计算表型方法。该模型显著优于传统机器学习及零样本LLM方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿片使用障碍（OUD）在美国仍是严重公共卫生危机，而电子健康记录（EHR）中由于诊断编码缺失及相关证据散见临床叙述，OUD难以精确识别。增强OUD识别对于临床干预和改善健康结局至关重要。

Method: 研究采用18项专家制定指标作为打分表，结合OPRO方法指导LLM自动从病历文本中提取关键信息及相关证据，用于OUD可计算表型的判定。由两位医生对253例患者的病历进行了人工复核，其中68例确认为OUD阳性。模型与传统EHR-ML和零样本LLM方法做效果对比。

Result: 所提LLM可计算表型模型取得了F1值0.774、AUROC值0.934，分别比基于EHR+NLP变量的传统机器学习模型和零样本LLM方法在F1指标上高12.8%和44.4%。

Conclusion: 本研究提出的基于LLM的OUD可计算表型不仅准确性优越，还能提供模型提取到的证据以增强解释性，有助于更好地支持OUD的临床识别和干预。

Abstract: Opioid use disorder (OUD) remains a public health crisis in the United States, yet it is difficult to identify from electronic health records (EHRs) because missing diagnosis codes and supporting evidence are buried in clinical narratives. Accurate OUD identification is critical to support interventions and improve health outcomes. This study developed a rubric-guided large language model (LLM) that incorporated Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) for OUD computable phenotyping (CP). The framework used an 18-item, expert-identified rubric to instruct LLMs to automatically extract critical text with supporting evidence to determine OUD flags. Two UF Health physicians (GMR and WMG) chart-reviewed 253 patients, including 68 OUD-positive cases. Our LLM-based computable phenotype (CP) achieved the best F1 score of 0.774 and an AUROC of 0.934, outperforming the machine learning-based CP using EHR and natural language processing-extracted variables, and zero-shot LLMs by relative F1 improvements of 12.8% and 44.4%, respectively. The proposed LLM-based CP could link LLM-extracted evidence to OUD phenotyping for better explainability.

</details>


### [307] [Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding for Common-Context Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05707)
*Theodore Glavas,Nikhita Vedula,Dushyanta Dhyani,Antonios Valkanas,Yilun Zhu,Shervin Malmasi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新方法IPPD，在大语言模型推理时，能在单个prompt内并行回答多个基于同一上下文的问题，极大提升了推理吞吐率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CCQA任务下，对于共享上下文的多问题，大语言模型通常分别对每个问题推理，有效性受限于显存瓶颈和GPU利用率不足。需要新方法更高效利用GPU推理能力，减少重复计算。

Method: 提出了Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD)推理方法，在单个Prompt中通过虚拟位置ID和注意力掩码操作，实现并行生成多个答案，无需对模型进行微调或架构更改，且完全兼容现有的批量推理流程。

Result: 实验证明，IPPD在不损失输出质量的前提下，推理吞吐率可达普通解码的7倍，并在多数环境下优于PagedAttention的prefix caching方法。

Conclusion: IPPD解决了CCQA中共享上下文多问题推理的瓶颈，实现高效并行推理，为大模型在实际应用中提升性能提供了一种简单有效的推理优化方案。

Abstract: In common-context question answering (CCQA) tasks, multiple input questions share a common context to base their answers from. However, Large Language Models typically generate each answer using an independent prompt. While existing batching and caching techniques help improve parallelism and reduce repeated computations, the separation of questions across prompts limits the achievable speedup, as modern GPUs are underutilized due to a memory bottleneck during attention. We present Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD), a novel inference method that answers multiple common-context questions in parallel within a single prompt. IPPD directly addresses the bottleneck by efficiently sharing both memory and computation during the attention process, as the next token for every question is decoded in a single inference step. IPPD uses virtual position IDs and attention mask manipulation to generate the same output as standard prompting without requiring fine-tuning or any changes to the LLM architecture. Since all parallelism occurs within a prompt, IPPD is fully compatible with batched inference, even when each prompt features a different context. Our experiments show that IPPD delivers up to 7X the effective throughput as standard decoding without quality degradation, and outperforms prefix caching with PagedAttention in most settings.

</details>


### [308] [MedWER: A Reproducible, Model-Free Evaluation Protocol for Medical Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05728)
*Justin Behling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种用于医学自动语音识别（ASR）新评估指标MedWER及其开源工具，专注于医疗关键信息的转录错误检测，而无需依赖实时NER模型或云API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ASR评估指标如WER无法反映关键医学实体（如药名）被误认时带来的严重后果，且现有针对医学实体的加权评估方法因需依赖外部NER工具，导致可复现性和标准化受限。为此，论文希望提出更透明、公平、可复用的医学ASR评估方法。

Method: MedWER使用一份包含19,373个覆盖药名、诊断、症状和伤害机制的固定医学词表，以及配套文本规范化组件，实现对医学实体转录的精准限制与评估。用严格版本管理的文本规范化器及术语约束WER，避免引入黑箱依赖，仅依赖公开可追溯资源。同时，使用独立的药品数据库校验覆盖率，并以人工标注实体作为匹配基准。

Result: 在Moonshine base、Whisper base.en、MedASR等ASR模型以及两个公开医学转录集上，利用所开发工具系统评测了MedWER及其置信区间，展示了评测流程的实际可行性与效果。

Conclusion: MedWER实现了无黑箱依赖的、以固定医学实体词表为基础的新型医学转录评测，提升了评测结果的透明性、可比性和可复现性，为医学ASR模型评价提供了标准化工具和流程。

Abstract: Overall word error rate hides clinically critical errors: a transcript can be 95% correct and still swap one drug for another. The usual fix weights errors on medical entities, and almost always depends on an evaluation-time named-entity recognition (NER) model or cloud API, which makes the metric's denominator a versioned black box. We present MedWER, an evaluation protocol and open-source tool for medical ASR whose denominator is a fixed, license-clean term list: 19,373 drug, diagnosis, symptom, and injury-mechanism entries projected from public sources. The protocol couples a pinned text normalizer with a phrase-aware term-restricted WER, the MedWER, so the only versioned component is a normalizer dependency held at an exact release and checked against committed golden fixtures. Coverage is validated against an independent provincial drug-benefit file the list was not built from; the matching heuristic is calibrated against ground-truth entity spans. Baselines for Moonshine~base, Whisper~base.en, and MedASR on two open benchmarks are scored with the released tool and reported with 95% confidence intervals from resampled per-utterance scores.

</details>


### [309] [Some Tokens Behave like Magnets: Revealing Linguistic Organization in the Layers of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05743)
*Andrew Liu,Devan Srinivasan,Gerald Penn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型（LLM）内部存在一种“磁性向量”，这些向量通过吸引或排斥作用，几何性地组织周围的token。该现象跨不同架构和任务广泛存在，移除这些向量会显著影响模型的语言处理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对LLM中token向量组织缺乏直观解释，本文旨在探索LLM内部token是如何以几何方式组织和处理语言的，寻求免探针的模型可解释性线索。

Method: 作者分析了LLM的token向量，定义并检测“磁性向量”，分析其对周围token的影响（拉长或压缩），并通过统计方法验证不同层级的磁性变化。他们还在fine-tune任务和消融实验中验证这些磁性向量的功能。

Result: 发现功能词在模型的早期层常为排斥磁体，模型深层的磁体排列方式会有变化。任务微调后，关键性token在最终层会变成排斥磁体。消除早期排斥磁体会极大破坏句法任务表现，消除晚期吸引磁体则影响语义任务。该现象对不同LLM架构和任务具有普遍性。

Conclusion: LLM内部存在有序的、层次化的磁性向量组织，这为揭示LLM几何化的语言处理机制、理解模型内部工作原理提供了新的无探针解释路径，并且值得进一步的深入研究。

Abstract: We identify a special group of token vectors inside large language models (LLMs), which we term magnetic vectors, that organize the surrounding tokens by either attracting or repelling them. Particularly, tokens pointing the same way as an attracting magnet are elongated; tokens pointing the same way as a repelling magnet are compressed. Just as physical magnets pull or push away the iron filings around them, these vectors organize their surroundings through two opposing polarities. Moreover, we identify a statistically significant pattern in linguistic category where function words consistently act as repelling magnets in early layers, and we also find magnets consistently reorganize their polarities in unique ways deeper in the model. In a further case study we find this observation may unveil a deliberate, layer-wise organization in how LLMs process language.
  This pattern is consistent across different LLM architectures, sizes, and layer configurations. It is also causally relevant. When the LLM is fine-tuned for a downstream task, the task-functional tokens emerge as magnets. E.g., in question answering, the answer-span tokens become uniquely repelling magnets in the final layer, geometrically carving the answer out of the surrounding context. Furthermore, removing early-layer repelling magnets devastates syntactic tasks (POS tagging accuracy drops from 91% to below 10%) while sparing semantic ones, and removing late-layer attracting magnets does the reverse. We believe this phenomenon warrants further investigation, as it opens the first probe-free path to understanding how language models geometrically organize linguistic computation across their layers.

</details>


### [310] [CrisisKD: Five-Stage Knowledge Distillation for Aspect-Level Sentiment and Emotion Analysis in Crisis Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05757)
*Marko Haralović,Onat Akca,Salih Eren Yücetürk,Minsi Li,Mariët Theune*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种新框架CrisisKD，通过知识蒸馏提升社交媒体危机情况下的细粒度情感与情绪分析，显著提升了模型效果，并开放了大规模标注数据集资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危机和健康相关场景下，识别情感词语所指对象对于理解公众舆情非常关键，但这类数据往往未标注，且存在跨文化、跨语言的复杂性。

Method: 设计了五阶段教师-学生知识蒸馏体系，教师LLM负责生成细粒度标签和推理过程，指导小型学生模型在方面抽取、句法分析、观点抽取、情感分类和情绪分类五任务上学习，并构建了大规模多标签数据集。

Result: CrisisKD显著提升了学生模型端到端方面级情感分析与情绪检测能力，且推理开销显著低于教师模型。在500条人工标注数据上，方面抽取、情绪及情感准确率均有明显提升。在公开基准ABEACrisisKD也有超越基线的表现。

Conclusion: CrisisKD有效提升了无标注社交媒体数据上的细粒度情感与情绪分析性能，降低了模型部署成本，并为研究者提供了可用的数据资源和工具。

Abstract: Identifying the target of emotional words or phrases in crisis situations, especially health-related ones, is important for understanding public concerns across cultural and linguistic contexts. We propose CrisisKD, a five-stage teacher--student knowledge distillation framework for aspect-level sentiment and emotion analysis on unannotated social media data. A teacher LLM generates aspect-level labels and reasoning traces that supervise a smaller student model across aspect extraction, syntactic parsing, opinion extraction, sentiment classification, and emotion classification. Using this framework, we construct and release a dataset containing 50,615 aspect-level labels, together with the annotation and fine-tuning scripts as open-source resources. The resulting student supports end-to-end ABSA and emotion detection at substantially lower inference cost than the teacher. On a manually annotated 500-tweet gold set, the 5-task Qwen2.5-7B student improves over the untuned model by 7.9 F1 points on aspect extraction, 17.0 points on emotion accuracy, and 6.5 points on sentiment accuracy. On the external ABEA benchmark, CrisisKD improves the same-model Qwen2.5-7B ICL baseline by 2.8 F1 points on ATE and 3.8 F1 points on joint ATE+AEC.

</details>


### [311] [Recall Is Not Protection: Evaluating Safety Monitors Against Model Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05797)
*Sripad Karne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文分析了部署到语言模型中的安全监控系统在识别有害请求方面的实际保护效果。作者发现，常用的评估指标（召回率）可能高估了监控系统的实际防护能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流做法是用召回率对安全监控器进行评估，但如果监控器拦截的本就不会被模型响应的有害请求，这样的评估其实并不能准确反映系统的防护效果。实际需关注模型会“配合”去响应的有害请求。

Method: 作者对不同语言模型和不同类别的安全监控器（包括激活探针、微调的文本监控、基于策略的大规模推理分类器等）进行实操测试。具体做法是重复采样模型对有害请求的多次响应，将至少一次“配合”回应的请求定义为“可诱发的”。分别统计监控器对可诱发和不可诱发有害请求的召回率，并分析未被监控器捕捉的提示被模型响应的概率。

Result: 在六种监控配置、三类模型上，监控器对“可诱发”请求的召回率比“不可诱发”请求低0.22至0.38，在相同的误报率下，监控器漏掉的有害请求比其成功捕捉到的有害请求被模型配合响应的概率高2.8~5.6倍。这一结果在不同监控器、不同模型间都被重复验证。

Conclusion: 用标准召回率衡量监控器性能会高估其实际防护能力。安全监控器应在关注模型实际会响应的有害请求上评估其召回，才能反映真实保护能力。

Abstract: Safety monitors screen prompts sent to deployed language models, flagging harmful requests so they are never answered. They are evaluated by recall against harmfulness labels, but a catch only prevents harm if the model would otherwise have complied. We measure the difference directly: we sample repeated responses from the target model, call a harmful prompt \emph{elicitable} if the model complies at least once, and report monitor recall separately on elicitable and non-elicitable prompts. Across six monitor configurations and three model families, spanning activation probes, fine-tuned text guards, and a 120B policy-conditioned reasoning classifier, recall on elicitable prompts falls 0.22 to 0.38 below recall on non-elicitable prompts at a fixed false positive rate. The prompts a monitor misses are 2.8 to 5.6 times more likely to be complied with than the prompts it catches. The gap replicates across three model families and appears also in text-only monitors entirely independent of the target model. This suggests that standard recall may overstate the protection monitors provide in practice, and that monitors should be evaluated against what their models will actually answer.

</details>


### [312] [Dynamic Lagging for Simultaneous Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05799)
*Hieu Hoang,Amittai Axelrod*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向前缀的微调方法，使LLM（如Qwen3-8B）在级联的同传系统中实现高质量、无闪烁的目标文本输出，并通过token置信度对延迟与质量进行灵活调控，超过了常用的wait-k等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 级联式同声传译中，机器翻译模块无法控制ASR的输出节奏，需要对不断增长的输入前缀决定翻译的输出量，如何在保证输出质量的同时，灵活控制延迟与输出的连续性，是该领域的重要难题。

Method: 将句子级训练的解码器仅LLM通过前缀相关的微调，使其对输入的稳定前缀敏感。具体做法是：用稳定前缀和全句对混合训练，再通过强制解码，将已生成目标前缀持续带入后续推理，确保输出连续、无闪烁。以Qwen3-8B为例，对英译德、日、中任务，模拟流式输入训练。并基于token置信度，实现延迟-质量的灵活调整，与wait-k和target-suffix-deletion等方法比较。

Result: 前缀微调可以在保持全句翻译质量的同时，提高最差区块（chunk）的质量，显著改善token级置信度校准（降低ECE）。实验证明，基于置信度阈值的训练外控件（threshold）在FLEURS、WMT24++、CoVoST 2等数据集与COMET、MetricX评价下，优于wait-k和target-suffix-deletion机制，在质量-延迟平衡上表现更佳。

Conclusion: 前缀微调配合置信度阈值控制，在级联同传中能提供更平滑的输出和更优质的延迟-质量权衡，为提升同传系统实用性提供了有效方法。

Abstract: In cascaded simultaneous speech translation, the machine translation (MT) system cannot control the read--write schedule of the upstream recognizer: it must decide, from a growing source prefix, how much target text to commit. We make a sentence-trained, decoder-only LLM prefix-aware by fine-tuning it on stable prefixes---the longest prefix that any translation up to the current partial source has shared with the model's own full-source output---mixed with full-sentence pairs, and prompt it through a single force-decode turn that carries the committed target forward as more source arrives, making the system flicker-free by construction. We fine-tune Qwen3-8B for EN to DE, JA, ZH, simulating the source stream with reference-transcript prefixes. Prefix finetuning preserves full-sentence quality while improving worst-position chunk quality, and it improves calibration of token-level commit confidence, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) on early source prefixes against a stable-prefix oracle. A single training-free threshold on that confidence is the most effective of the three latency controls we compare: it traces a continuous quality--latency frontier that outperforms the discrete wait-$k$ and target-suffix-deletion quality-latency tradeoff mechanisms. The effect holds well on FLEURS, WMT24++, and CoVoST~2 test sets, under both COMET and MetricX.

</details>


### [313] [AtomCite: Verification and Correction of Supplied Page-Level Citations in Multi-Page Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05802)
*Chen Qian,Yimeng Wang,Yu Chen,Lingfei Wu,Andreas Stathopoulos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于核查和修正文档多页引用的新框架AtomCite，并开发了首个面向此任务的基准DocCite。实验显示，AtomCite显著提升了页级引用的验证和修正效果，并在不同模型和数据集上具有很强的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在问答任务中需为答案提供所依据文档的页级引用，但当前方法存在引用不准确和评估不全面的问题。此前无基准专门衡量模型能否检查和修正已附加的页级引用。为解决这一空白，作者提出了新的系统和评估基准。

Method: 提出“AtomCite”框架，将答案解析为若干主张，逐一在被引用的原始页面图像上核查，并利用确定性修正策略纠正错误引用。为评估该框架，作者开发了DocCite基准数据集，基于现有文档问答数据集（MP-DocVQA和DUDE），引入已验证的错误注入案例和候选的自然错误，采用双人工审核进一步确认标注质量，并以确定性方法分派主要标签。

Result: AtomCite在注入的基准集上的二元验证准确率达93%，显著优于所有“仅依赖OCR”的对照组，也优于所有同样OCR文本做基础的先前文本方法。其修正策略将引用准确率从构造的34%提升到87-90%，并保留90%以上的正确主张。此外，AtomCite在无需再训练的情况下提升了两款开源模型在多个公开基准上的“幻觉检测”表现，超越直接做裁判的同模型。

Conclusion: AtomCite提升了文档问答系统引用的核查和修正水平，其方法泛化性强，可直接用于多种基准和模型。仅靠机器合成或自动标签评估会产生噪声和偏倚，容易误判模型效能，强调了结合人工审核评测的重要性。

Abstract: Large language models answering questions over multi-page documents are expected to cite the supporting pages, yet supplied citations are sometimes inaccurate, and current evaluations score citations at generation time or against text passages: no existing benchmark evaluates whether a system can verify and correct a page-level citation already attached to an answer. We propose AtomCite, an agentic framework that parses an answer into claims, checks each claim against the image of its cited page, and applies a deterministic repair policy. To evaluate it, we introduce DocCite, to our knowledge the first benchmark for systems that verify and correct page-level citations in document images. Built on MP-DocVQA and DUDE, it combines 928 validated injected instances with 2,468 candidate natural errors harvested from frontier- and efficiency-tier models, of which a two-annotator audit confirms 1,909 as genuine errors. Primary labels are assigned deterministically, not by LLM judges, with the human audit as a separate validation layer. Across three model families (Gemini, Claude, and GPT), AtomCite reaches around 93% binary verification accuracy on the injected benchmark, significantly outperforming every OCR-only condition, including a compute-matched control, and exceeding every prior text-based baseline given the same OCR text. Its repair policy lifts citation precision on the injected mix from a constructed 34% to 87-90% while retaining over 90% of correct claims. AtomCite also transfers: with frozen prompts and zero training, it raises the hallucination-detection scores of two open 7-8B models on five public benchmarks above the same models prompted as direct judges. Finally, the audit shows that noise in automatic labels biases measured verifier accuracy and can reverse system rankings, so evaluations relying only on synthetic or automatic labels risk mismeasuring verification capability.

</details>


### [314] [CONDUIT: A Unified Residual-Stream Restoration Framework for KV Cache Reuse in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05821)
*Pengan Chen,Kaisheng Zheng,Liang Hong,Lixia Yi,Jiyue Jiang,Jiayang Chen,Yixuan Wang,Yimin Fan,Xinyuan Liu,Jiayi Li,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的视觉-语言模型KV缓存刷新方法CONDUIT，可在只用10%视觉token预算时，避免重复计算，并保持接近全部输入的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs常面对相似视觉内容的重复问题，传统缓存重用在前缀变化时表现不佳，而现有刷新策略又易导致计算资源浪费。因此需要高效、智能的缓存刷新办法。

Method: 提出CONDUIT，这是一种基于缓存key-query attention和value-norm的训练无关缓存刷新策略，通过单次评分挑选需刷新视觉token，既能单图像又能多图像适用，仅在推理阶段有一轮额外打分，完全保持模型架构和参数不变。

Result: 在五个数据集、三种VLM架构上，用10%刷新预算可达到97.0-99.5%全输入精度；在MMLongBench-Doc延迟子集上，仅用13.5%计算量，推理首token提速2.99倍。

Conclusion: CONDUIT在保证高精度和低资源消耗下，实现了更灵活高效的视觉KV缓存刷新，为VLM实际应用带来计算效率和响应速度的突破。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often answer new questions about recurring visual content, where reusing the key-value (KV) cache can avoid re-encoding expensive visual prefixes. Exact-prefix reuse, however, fails when the same visual content appears under a changed prefix. Selective recomputation can recover quality under a small visual-token budget, but only when the right stale tokens are refreshed. Raw-attention selection can waste budget on high-attention tokens with small value-norm proxy scores and on query-irrelevant images. To address these failure modes, we propose CONDUIT, a training-free refresh policy that unifies single- and multi-image reuse as residual-stream restoration. Building on norm-weighted attention, CONDUIT ranks cached visual tokens using cached-key query attention and an accessible pre-output cached-value-norm proxy, then applies empirical image-level relevance amplification before one global selection. With one image, the coefficient is one and the rule reduces to intra-image token selection. The method preserves model architecture and weights, adding only a single query-conditioned scoring pass at inference. At a 10% refresh budget, CONDUIT achieves 97.0-99.5% of the corresponding full-prefill five-dataset average across three VLM backbones and leads budgeted methods on average; on the MMLongBench-Doc latency subset, it uses 13.5% of full-prefill FLOPs and achieves a 2.99x time-to-first-token speedup.

</details>


### [315] [SinoGlyphBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Chinese Glyph-Level Obfuscation in Language-Model Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05843)
*Yifan Wang,Zimu Wang,Suliu Qin,Changyu Zeng,Tong Chen,Siqi Chen,Yijie Lin,Lingyu Jiang,Jionglong Su,Yushan Pan,Haiyang Zhang,Wei Wang,Qiaoyu Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SinoGlyphBench基准，用于评估字形扰动对中文有害内容自动审核系统的影响，并发现当前主流模型对字形伪装鲁棒性较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动内容审核系统在处理中文时，常因用户使用字形伪装逃避检测，导致有害内容无法有效识别。缺乏专门的基准来系统性分析模型对此类伪装的脆弱性。

Method: 作者构建了SinoGlyphBench基准，通过确定与标签相关的语义锚点，将原始内容与对应字形扰动后的内容配对，涵盖文本和图像双模态，并系统扰动锚点、背景或两者。对12个大型语言模型和多模态模型进行了大规模实验评测。

Result: 字形伪装使有害内容的假阴性提升6.1%，假阳性提升4.7%，四分类准确率下降5%。模型对原始内容的正确判断有75.7%能迁移到伪装内容。完全扰动影响最大，仅锚点扰动比仅背景扰动更具破坏性，字符跨脚本替换在文本模式下尤其困难。分析揭示模型的可见读音、意图还原和安全判断间常不一致。

Conclusion: 现有标准模型在应对中文非规范字形的有害内容时表现脆弱，SinoGlyphBench为诊断与改进这类问题提供了工具和数据集。

Abstract: Glyph-level obfuscation can leave harmful Chinese content readable to humans while degrading automated moderation. We introduce SinoGlyphBench, a diagnostic benchmark that identifies label-critical semantic anchors and creates matched original and glyph-obfuscated inputs in text and image modalities. By perturbing anchors, background context, or both, this design distinguishes corruption of moderation-relevant evidence from general surface variation. Across 176,916 paired evaluations of 12 LLMs and MLLMs, obfuscation increases harmful false-negative and false-positive rates by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively, and reduces four-way accuracy by 5.0 points. Models retain 75.7% of the decisions that were correct on the matched original inputs. Full-scope perturbations cause the largest degradation, anchor-only perturbations are more damaging than background-only perturbations, and cross-script substitution is particularly difficult in the text modality. Analysis of structured outputs identifies observable mismatches in visible-form reading, intended-message recovery, and final safety judgment. The evaluated models, therefore, remain brittle to Chinese content written with non-canonical glyphs. Resources are available at https://github.com/fengshun124/SinoGlyphBench.

</details>


### [316] [What if LLMs Ate Their Words: Causal History Effects in Multi-Turn Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05882)
*Jinnan Li,Zheren Fu,Yue Wang,Jinzhe Li,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 多轮交互中，大模型自身生成的历史内容会影响后续表现，不同模型和任务中表现不同，对其进行有选择性的干预可提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究发现大模型（LLM）在多轮对话中表现变差，且由其自身生成的历史内容会影响后续，但具体机制及影响范围尚不清楚。

Method: 作者在六类任务、五个模型上比较了单轮（FULL）与多轮（SHARDED）输入下的性能变化。分别替换历史助手回复为中立内容（neutralization），并逐步修改单个助手回复（Turn Surgery），分析对模型行为的影响。还通过权重开放模型的案例追踪内部状态的变化。

Result: 多轮交互下性能下降依赖于任务和模型类型。中立化历史内容后，对近3000个对话性能有明显提升且与单纯缩短上下文不同。逐步干预发现，约2/3有正向改善，部分任务能实现由失败到成功的逆转。模型内部状态变化因任务而异，没有普遍规律。

Conclusion: 助手生成的历史在多轮表现中有选择性影响，应采用针对性而非统一的历史管理策略以优化LLM多轮交互表现。

Abstract: Multi-turn interaction creates a feedback process in which an LLM's previous responses become context for later behavior. Prior work shows substantial multi-turn degradation and that assistant-generated history can affect later behavior. However, it remains unclear how these effects manifest across models, tasks, turns, and inside a model. We study these gaps across six task families and five models. Degradation from fully specified single-turn input (FULL) to progressively revealed multi-turn interaction (SHARDED) is clearly task- and model-dependent, and stronger one-shot performance does not imply greater interaction robustness. We then retrospectively analyze completed SHARDED conversations by replaying the user messages already observed in each trajectory while editing only assistant-generated history. Replacing prior assistant responses with neutral content (termed neutralization) changes downstream min-max normalized performance by +.027 across 2,973 trajectories. On a prespecified length-controlled subset, short and length-matched neutralization yield nearly identical effects (+.069 versus +.068), showing that simple context shortening is insufficient to explain the effect of history editing. Turn Surgery further intervenes on one assistant turn at a time. Among 237 selected degraded trajectories, 63.7% contain at least one beneficial intervention, while most tested positions remain unchanged; for binary tasks, 48.4% admit a fail-to-success reversal. An open-weight case study links behaviorally consequential history changes to measurable downstream state differences, but finds task-dependent rather than universal internal signatures. Overall, assistant-generated history has active but selective effects on multi-turn performance, motivating selective rather than uniform history management.

</details>


### [317] [AlignDiff: Exploiting Model-Intrinsic Information for Better Preference Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05899)
*Peng Lai,He Zhu,Zhiwen Ruan,Dongdong Zhang,Yun Chen,Peng Li,Furu Wei,Yang Liu,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出了一种称为AlignDiff的数据筛选框架，通过模型内在信号过滤和排序偏好数据，有效提升大型语言模型的人类偏好对齐性能。在多个模型和基准上表现优于七种现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型要实现与人类偏好的对齐，数据质量极为关键。然而现有偏好数据或多或少存在噪声和分布偏移，严重影响模型效果。因此，研究者希望构建更好的数据筛选机制以提升对齐质量。

Method: 作者提出AlignDiff方法，该方法利用模型自身的正反信号，自动筛选出偏好明显的数据样本，并通过平均负对数似然差分对难度较高的数据进行优先训练，以促进模型对信息的更深层次学习。同时进行了多基线和消融实验验证效果。

Result: AlignDiff在LLaMA和Qwen两个主流模型，以及AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard和MT-Bench三大广泛使用的基准测试中，都取得了优于七种强基线方法的显著效果。

Conclusion: AlignDiff能有效筛选和利用高价值的偏好数据，显著提升模型对齐性能。基于难度的课程学习策略也被证明有助于进一步提升效果。

Abstract: Aligning large language models with human preferences remains a challenge, primarily due to the critical role of preference data quality in effective alignment. Existing datasets are frequently plagued by inherent noise and distribution shifts, which inherently limit model performance. To bridge this gap, we propose AlignDiff, a preference data filtering framework driven by intrinsic model signals. AlignDiff first identifies samples with clear preferences using both positive and inverse signals, then prioritizes the more challenging samples based on the average negative log-likelihood gap, encouraging the model to learn richer information from them. AlignDiff is evaluated on two widely used model families (LLaMA and Qwen) and three benchmarks widely adopted in the alignment community (AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench). Across all settings, it consistently outperforms seven strong baselines. We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of AlignDiff, and further show that difficulty-based curriculum learning improves model performance.

</details>


### [318] [From Narrative to Auditable Forecasts: A Structured Scaffold for Agentic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05905)
*Yuanpu Cao,Yongkang Du,Yurui Chang,Lu Lin,Jinghui Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为AuditForecast的结构化概率预测框架，大幅提升了大模型代理在实时预测任务中的准确性、可审计性和性价比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大模型(agent)用于实时预测时，往往依赖非结构化的叙述性聚合，导致预测缺乏明确的证据—概率关系，影响预测的准确性和结果可追溯性。

Method: AuditForecast以定量基线模型为锚点，通过模型引导获取数据，推导基础概率，然后以odds space中的机械方法结构化地整合情境因素，实现由结构化中介物承载的全过程预测生成。

Result: 在多个实时预测基准任务上，AuditForecast不仅准确性、校正性优于强基线，还在多个场景下超过市场隐含参考，并显著优于高成本的深度调研型agent，且在性价比上保持优势。

Conclusion: AuditForecast使预测流程更结构化和透明，便于事后系统性分析，有效提升了预测的表现和可审计性。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for live forecasting, where they retrieve up-to-date information and produce estimates for unresolved future events. However, current agentic forecasting often relies on implicit narrative aggregation: agents collect evidence, discuss it in prose, and often assign a probability without an explicit update path from evidence to forecast. This limits both forecasting accuracy and auditability. We propose AuditForecast, an agentic scaffold for structured probabilistic forecasting. AuditForecast first anchors the forecast with a suitable quantitative baseline model, uses model-guided data retrieval to derive a base probability, and then applies situational factor updates outside the model's scope through mechanical aggregation in odds space. This turns forecasting from a prose-based judgment into a structured process with explicit intermediate objects. Across multiple live forecasting benchmarks, AuditForecast improves forecasting accuracy and calibration relative to strong agentic baselines, surpasses market-implied references in several settings, and outperforms substantially more expensive deep-research agents while remaining Pareto-dominant in the cost--accuracy tradeoff. Beyond performance gains, AuditForecast produces an auditable forecasting report that makes forecast construction explicit and supports systematic post hoc analysis.

</details>


### [319] [UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05910)
*Peng Lai,Yichao Du,Junchao Wu,Weibo Gao,Linan Yue,Longyue Wang,Weihua Luo,Derek F. Wong,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了MixReward大型多语言数据集及统一推理奖励模型UniRRM，有效提升了在开放任务中奖励建模的可靠性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放式任务中，现有RL奖励模型要么依赖昂贵、不透明的LLM-as-a-Judge系统，要么是可解释性弱、评价标准固定、支持语言有限，因此需要更可靠、高效且多语言支持的奖励建模方法。

Method: 作者构建MixReward数据集，涵盖六大领域、103种语言，并包含成对和序列式标注数据；设计UniRRM模型，采用分阶段推理链动态生成泛化任务与指令相关的评判标准，实现多语言和自适应、细粒度评判。

Result: 实验证明UniRRM-8B和UniRRM-14B在多个基准任务上与同体量最先进模型表现接近，对未见过的评价范式也有效。消融实验进一步验证了模型的可靠性和有效性。

Conclusion: MixReward和UniRRM提升了奖励模型的可扩展性、可解释性及多语言适应能力，有助于RL在开放任务中的应用。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{MixReward}, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose \textbf{UniRRM}, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.

</details>


### [320] [Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05913)
*Zeyu Wu,Junchao Wu,Shudong Liu,Runzhe Zhan,Xin Chen,Shu Yang,Yichao Du,Longyue Wang,Weihua Luo,Jinsong Su,Derek F. Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于神经元激活模式的指导微调框架（NGFT），综合优化参数冗余、数据选择和遗忘等问题，在多个模型和任务中优于主流方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的监督微调，尤其是全参数微调，存在参数冗余、数据质量不一致及灾难性遗忘等多重问题，已有方法往往各自为政，缺乏统一的优化信号。

Method: 提出了神经元指导微调（NGFT）框架，通过三种机制协同工作：（1）自适应任务神经元选择，一次前向传播确定关键神经元并集中更新以减少冗余；（2）基于激活的数据选择，优先选择对关键神经元贡献大的高信息样本；（3）神经元激活对齐，设计了新的损失函数，使激活保持与预训练状态一致以增强泛化和知识保留。

Result: 实验证明，在三个不同模型、多个任务（专业和通用数据集）上，NGFT在效率和性能方面均明显优于现有主流微调方法，并显著减轻了灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: NGFT为微调流程提供了统一且高效的优化思路，可有效解决以往方法各自为政的问题，提升微调效果并保留通用知识。

Abstract: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting, which current methods typically address in isolation and lack a unified optimization signal to bridge data selection, parameter updates, and knowledge preservation. To address this, we propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, which identifies essential neurons in a single forward pass to concentrate updates and reduce redundancy; (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states, deepening representation learning and preserving general knowledge. Experimental results across three models across both domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that NGFT significantly outperforms existing mainstream fine-tuning methods in both efficiency and performance, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [321] [Solving versus Verifying: Catching Contradictions in Tax Reasoning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05928)
*Albert Sadowski,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型在标准税务案例中表现优异，但遇到事实缺失或矛盾的真实输入时，直接输出结果可能极具误导性。通过引入模型自我验证机制，可大幅提升对矛盾输入的可靠检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在标准、完整的税法题库上准确率很高，被视为税务咨询与合规系统的候选方案。然而，现实法律问题常常存在事实缺失或矛盾，模型在这些情况下的表现和可靠性亟需评估。

Method: 研究团队对六个主流大模型，在SARA衍生税务案例下，故意注入事实缺失和事实矛盾，考察其在解题和输入验证两种情景下的表现，并测试通过增加一次自检（contradiction gate）来提升整体可靠性。

Result: 最强模型能在事实缺失时选择放弃作答，但在事实矛盾时大多仍计算并输出自信但有误的答案，且未能识别矛盾。若让同一模型转为验证输入，大多能发现这些矛盾。引入简单自我验证机制后，大幅提升了对矛盾的检出率，且准确率下降极小（仅约5个百分点）。

Conclusion: 高准确率并不代表模型完全可靠，在真实存在输入缺陷时，模型可能给出危险误导性的答案。但无需复杂升级，通过一次自检即可显著提升安全性与可靠性，这为模型在法律等敏感领域的应用指明了改进方向。

Abstract: Large language models now compute correct tax liabilities on over 90% of well-formed cases in statutory benchmarks, which makes them candidates for the tax-advisory and compliance systems that consume such an answer directly. Real legal inputs, however, are frequently defective: required facts are missing, or stated facts contradict one another. Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong. This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input? We study six recent models on SARA-derived tax cases under missing-fact and contradictory-fact perturbations. The strongest models abstain when a fact is missing but compute through injected contradictions, returning the clean-input answer 63-76% of the time with no signal of the conflict; asked instead to verify the same input, they flag most of those contradictions. We wire that verification call into a simple contradiction gate: one extra call that abstains when the model reports a conflict. Across all six models it recovers most of the missed contradiction abstention at a clean-accuracy cost of at most about 5 percentage points, with no training and no external tooling. High accuracy on well-formed inputs is therefore an incomplete measure of reliability, and the detection the solver misses is cheaply recoverable with a single self-check.

</details>
