Conclusion: 多指机器人手灵巧性是多维度复杂问题，分层基准有助于系统性评测。新的基准和指标为今后机器人手研究与发展提供参考和方向。

Abstract: Robot hands are a key interface between AI and the physical world, making advances in robotic dexterity essential to realizing the vision of physical AI. While impressive dexterity has been demonstrated with simple grippers, multifingered hands offer the potential for substantially greater versatility, precision, and adaptability in manipulation. In this review, we survey the state of the art in benchmarking the dexterity of multifingered robot hands. Recognizing dexterity as a complex and multifaceted concept, we present the perspective of the U.S. National Science Foundation HAND Engineering Research Center, with a particular focus on fine in-hand manipulation. We introduce a framework consisting of three benchmark levels that correspond to increasing system complexity, review representative benchmarks at each level, and propose new benchmarks and metrics to address limitations in the literature. More information can be found at https://hand-erc.github.io/benchmarking/.

</details>


### [470] [GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05588)
*AgiBot Research Team,Renhang Liu,Wenzhi Zhao,Zhuo Yang,Liliang Chen,Pengfei Zhou,Shengcong Chen,Guanghui Ren,Youlun Peng,Rongjun Jin,Nan Wang,Sukai Wang,Xindong He,Jinyuan Feng,Ziyu Xiong,Linqing Zhong,Yifei Wei,Feng Han,Long Zhang,Da Huang,Nanshu Zhao,Chenghao Yin,Mo Wu,Zhaodong Yan,Kongtao Hu,Yuxiang Yan,Aogelijiang Niyazi,Yu Fang,Jia Zeng,Lizhu Meng,Daizhen Lv,Haoyu Cao,Zhiwen Hou,Lianjin Ye,Yuehan Niu,Zhikai Cai,Xuan Hu,Hui Min,Xiongfeng Cai,Yue Liao,Jing Wu,Soujanya Poria,Ye Li,Sanping Zhou,Maoqing Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从零开始训练的世界-动作模型GE-Act 2.0，结合多种模块实现泛化能力提升，并在大规模任务上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数世界-动作模型（WAM）依赖于预训练的视频生成器，鲜有关注WAM本身的预训练与可扩展性，限制了机器人在新环境中的泛化和任务转移能力。

Method: GE-Act 2.0模型包括三部分：高压缩控制自编码器（CoAE）、单步视觉规划器（SVP）、逆动力学模型（IDM）。采用独特的知识对齐选择优化（KASO）方式进行联合训练，通过只选择与实际行为兼容的预测未来状态，减少监督信号的不匹配。预训练后直接进行多任务测试，无需针对具体任务微调。

Result: 在20类操作技能、100个任务和不同场景中评估模型，数据量扩大至3万小时，性能大幅提升，G1-OP从17.1%提升到44.1%，G2-90D从13.4%提升到31.1%，实现了技能及跨形态迁移。相关性分析显示技能覆盖度与零样本OOD成功率高度相关。模型能稳定理解和执行条件指令。

Conclusion: GE-Act 2.0在多种技能和任务中展现了良好的泛化性及跨环境迁移能力，实现了世界-动作模型的可扩展高效预训练，推动了机器人自主学习和泛化能力的发展。

Abstract: World-action models (WAM) predict future states to guide robot actions, enabling learning from both action-free video and action-labeled interaction. Most inherit pretrained video generators, leaving WAM pretraining and scaling underexplored. We introduce Genie Envisioner Act 2.0 (GE-Act 2.0), a world-action model whose trainable generative and action components are all initialized from scratch on manipulation data. It combines a control-oriented autoencoder (CoAE), a single-step visual planner (SVP), and an inverse dynamics model (IDM). CoAE retains action- and instruction-relevant information under aggressive compression, while SVP produces a complete future state in one differentiable pass, so visual planning and inverse dynamics can be pretrained separately on complementary data. The components are then jointly trained with knowledge-aligned selective optimization (KASO), which reduces mismatched supervision by selecting only predicted futures judged behaviorally compatible with the recorded action. We evaluate pretrained checkpoints directly, without per-task fine-tuning, on 100 tasks across 20 manipulation skill groups with held-out scenes, backgrounds, lighting, and object instances. Scaling co-training data from 300 to 30,000 hours raises success from 17.1% to 44.1% on G1-OP and from 13.4% to 31.1% on G2-90D; despite comprising less than 2% of the co-training data, G2-90D improves by 17.7 points, suggesting cross-embodiment transfer. Gains span 19/20 and 18/20 skill groups, and skill-specific coverage strongly correlates with zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) success (Pearson r=0.80; Spearman rho=0.85). Under the same protocol, the model grounds object, color, shape, and position references in at least 90% of trials and follows explicit instructions even when they conflict with an already-committed behavior or a conventional scene association.

</details>


### [471] [Adaptive Cost-Sensitive Machine Learning for Autonomous Robot Navigation Failure Prediction: When Not All Errors Are Equal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05593)
*Rifa Ferzana*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种基于情境后果的自主机器人导航失败预测方法，并验证了其在提升高风险场景下预测准确性和降低后果成本方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前导航失败的预测通常只关注失败的类别或严重性，忽略了其发生的物理情境（如速度、感知质量、障碍物距离）。然而，不同情境下同类型失败的后果严重性不同，因此有必要开发同时考虑情境与后果的预测机制，从而更合理地指导机器人采取更保守或激进的行动策略。

Method: 方法上，作者首先基于失败严重性构建权重调整的基线模型，然后提出自适应扩展方法：该方法定义了一个“后果函数”，同时结合了严重性、归一化速度、障碍物距离及感知不确定性，还引入了一个随情境恶化上升的风险敏感项。在训练和评估中，使用了大规模仿真和UCI SCITOS G5外部数据集，并采用GroupKFold方式验证泛化能力。

Result: 固定权重能显著提升高严重性事件的召回率（从0.851到0.985），并大幅降低“错失后果”带来的成本（从1940降到313）；自适应方法进一步提升至0.998与82。碰撞实验中召回率也有显著提升，同时错失碰撞的成本大幅降低。

Conclusion: 文中提出的情境相关后果建模可依据物理风险动态调整保守程度，为安全关键型导航决策提供了有理论支撑的方法，尤其适用于需在复杂或不确定环境下运行的机器人系统。

Abstract: Autonomous robot navigation failures differ not only in categorical severity but also in the physical context in which they occur. A near-miss at low speed under reliable sensing is not equivalent to the same event during rapid motion, close obstacle approach or degraded perception. This paper reframes navigation failure prediction as consequence-sensitive forecasting. We first establish a fixed baseline in which training weights are modulated by categorical severity, then introduce an adaptive extension defining a state-dependent consequence function combining severity with normalised velocity, obstacle proximity and sensing uncertainty, together with a risk-sensitivity term that rises as conditions deteriorate. We evaluate on 2,000 simulated differential-drive episodes (~1,000,000 timesteps) using episode-level GroupKFold, with external validation on the UCI SCITOS G5 dataset. Fixed weighting raises Logistic Regression high-severity recall from 0.851 to 0.985 and reduces missed consequence cost from 1,940 to 313; the adaptive extension reaches 0.998 and 82. Under matched false-positive conditions, however, the discriminative advantage is modest (0.986 versus 0.984), so most of the gain reflects a more conservative operating point rather than better ranking. The effect is consistent across all five folds and stable across a threefold span of context coefficients. Because the primary simulation produced no collisions, we add a controlled extension in which 108 of 600 episodes terminate in contact: collision recall rises from 0.850 to 0.966 (fixed) and 0.984 (adaptive), with missed collision cost falling from 1,000 to 105, at false-positive rates of 0.413 and 0.799, respectively. Context-dependent consequence modelling thus provides a principled mechanism for allocating conservatism by physical risk.

</details>


### [472] [Closed-Loop Evaluation of Bird's-Eye-View Maps from Cross-View Transformers as Inputs to Behavior-Cloning Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05783)
*Felipe Carlos dos Santos,Eric Antonelo,Gustavo Claudio Karl Couto*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究将基于Cross-View Transformer（CVT）预测的鸟瞰图（BEV）直接作为行为克隆（BC）自动驾驶策略输入，并提出KDE加权方案提升关键路段预测质量。结果显示KDE模型在端到端评估中安全性更高，即使其全局分割精度（IoU）并非最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶研究多依赖高精度的仿真鸟瞰图（BEV），但真实部署需用摄像头预测的BEV，可能引入感知误差，其对自动驾驶端到端性能影响尚不明确。

Method: 在CARLA仿真中，用Cross-View Transformer（CVT）从相机图像预测6通道BEV（道路、路线、车道线、车辆、行人、红绿灯），并提出KDE加权方案，提升对曲线和路口等低频驾驶场景的分割表现。然后用该BEV作为行为克隆（BC）策略的直接输入进行封闭环驾驶评估。

Result: 在两个CARLA小镇的测试结果中，经KDE加权的预测BEV模型是唯一能无违规完成全程任务的非真实BEV模型，尽管并非IoU最高。说明全局分割性能和驾驶优劣之间未必正相关，关键位置的预测质量更重要。

Conclusion: IoU等全局分割指标无法有效反映自动驾驶的真实端到端性能。精度提升应聚焦几何关键处，路线预测质量是提升BC策略端到端性能的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: In autonomous driving, Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representations provide a structured, top-down abstraction of the vehicle's surroundings and have become a key input modality for Behavioral Cloning (BC) policies. While ground-truth BEV maps are readily available in simulation, real-world deployment requires replacing them with camera-predicted counterparts - a substitution that introduces perceptual errors whose downstream impact on closed-loop driving performance is not well understood. In this work, we investigate the use of Cross-View Transformer (CVT)-predicted BEV maps as direct policy inputs for a BC agent in the CARLA simulator. We propose a six-channel BEV representation covering road surface, planned route, lane boundaries, vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic lights, and introduce a Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) weighting scheme that rebalances the segmentation loss towards underrepresented driving maneuvers such as curves and intersections. Closed-loop evaluation across two CARLA towns shows that the KDE-weighted model is the only predicted-BEV agent to complete a full episode without infractions, despite not achieving the highest aggregate IoU. This discrepancy reveals that global segmentation metrics are poor proxies for driving performance: what determines navigation success is prediction quality at geometrically critical locations, and the route channel emerges as the primary bottleneck for reliable agent navigation under predicted BEV inputs.

</details>


### [473] [CR-VLA-Force: Learning Control-aware Compliance VLA Model for Robust Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05832)
*Zhaohong Mai,Chao Wang,Chao Zeng,Sitong Mao,Heng Zhang,Shunbo Zhou,Chenguang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结合视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与力/力矩（F/T）感知的新型控制框架CC-VLA，以提升机器人操作的模仿学习中对精确力控制和快速调整的能力。通过多模态专家混合、分阶段训练和自适应柔顺性控制，大大提升了困难任务的成功率和力控精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具备力感知的VLA模型常因动作片段的执行策略和感知-控制延迟过大，导致力追踪不精准、反应不够及时，出现操作失败甚至安全隐患。解决这一问题对于提升机器人与环境复杂交互时的安全性和可靠性十分关键。

Method: CC-VLA采用多模态专家混合（MoE）架构，将力信号序列、融合视觉与语言特征输入模型。同时使用多阶段训练增强在视觉语义空间下的识别及稀疏采样力信号下的感知鲁棒性。针对不同任务，设计了VLA引导的自适应柔顺控制器，实现无接触运动时的高精度位置控制，以及接触丰富任务下的优化力-位跟踪。此外，采用对抗性共享远程操作技术，采集高质量F/T演示数据，提升系统安全与可操作性。

Result: 实验证明，CC-VLA在真实环境下显著提升了困难力感知任务的成功率和力控制精度，并在部分超出分布（partial-OOD）的位姿偏移下表现出多层次的安全性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CC-VLA框架能够有效解决当前VLA模型在力感知与快速调整上的局限，为复杂机器人操作任务提供了更高的成功率、力控精度以及系统的安全与鲁棒性，具有广泛的实际应用前景。

Abstract: Integrating visuomotor policies or Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with force/torque (F/T) perception has demonstrated significant progress in imitation learning for robotic manipulation. However, existing force-aware VLA models frequently exhibit limited capability in precise force tracking and rapid successive adjustments. This deficiency stems from the limitations of action-chunk execution strategies and the substantial latency between perception and real-time control. Such limitations can lead to task failures and safety risks, particularly when the execution of an action chunk exerts excessive interaction forces without timely adjustment. To overcome this challenge, we propose the Control-aware Compliance VLA (CC-VLA) framework for reactive control. The CC-VLA model employs a multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) to encode force signal sequences and vision-language fused feature. Furthermore, it utilizes a multi-stage training strategy to ensure robust perception within the visual-semantic space and effective force perception under sparse sampling conditions. Additionally, a VLA-guided adaptive compliance controller is designed to facilitate precise position tracking during contact-free motion and optimal force-position tracking for contact-rich tasks. To facilitate high-precision F/T data acquisition, we also implement an adversaria shared teleoperation strategy for contact-rich demonstrations that bolsters system safety and interactivity. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that CC-VLA significantly improves success rates in challenging force-perception tasks and enhances force-control precision, while providing multi-level safety and robustness under the tested partial-OOD pose-shift settings.

</details>


### [474] [A4A: Cross-Embodiment Transfer of Action-Oriented 4D Affordances from Human Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05892)
*Yifan Han,Litao Liu,Yuqi Gu,Ye Lu,Hanqing Wang,Sidney Wai,Ishaan Myrie,Qi Zhang,Jingjin Yu,Gen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了以动作为导向的4D可供性表达，能够捕捉与任务相关的三维点在未来的轨迹，推动了人类操作知识向机器人控制的高效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往的可供性表示大多只告诉机器人“哪里”可以交互，但实际机器人操作还需要理解“如何”交互过程中目标的几何演变，从而更好地迁移人类操作知识。

Method: 作者提出了基于语言条件的动作导向4D可供性描述，将与任务相关的三维点未来轨迹作为核心表达，并从现有的人物-物体交互视频与RGB-D演示中构建了大规模数据集；同时提出A4A框架，将4D可供性轨迹预测用于机器人策略预训练。

Result: 在仿真和真实的机器人实验中，使用4D可供性数据预训练一系列视觉-语言-动作机器人策略，均表现出操作性能的显著提升。

Conclusion: 基于动作导向的4D可供性是转移人类操作知识到机器人控制的有效跨形体表达方式。

Abstract: Human demonstrations contain rich manipulation knowledge, but it remains unclear what information can be transferred effectively to robot control. Existing affordance representations are typically formulated as 2D masks, 3D regions, contact points, or actionability scores, and therefore primarily identify where interaction may occur. However, effective manipulation also requires modeling how interaction-relevant geometry evolves during task execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce action-oriented 4D affordances, which represent the language-conditioned future trajectories of interaction-relevant 3D points. These trajectories capture task-conditioned geometric evolution rather than embodiment-specific actions, enabling transferable interaction priors across humans and robots. Based on this representation, we construct a large-scale action-oriented 4D affordance dataset from existing human--object interaction video data and complementary RGB-D demonstrations, and introduce A4A, an affordance-to-action framework that uses 4D affordance trajectory prediction to pretrain robot policies before manipulation fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and the real world validate the effectiveness of A4A, showing that pretraining with action-oriented 4D affordance data consistently improves the manipulation performance of diverse VLA policies. These results establish action-oriented 4D affordances as an effective cross-embodiment representation for transferring manipulation knowledge from human demonstrations to robot control.

</details>


### [475] [GIF: Agentic Generation of Interactive and Functional Object Compositions for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05927)
*Long Xu,Zhiqi Zhang,Mi Yan,Shengliang Deng,Chong Xia,Mingyu Dong,Jiayi Chen,Jiangran Lyu,Fei Gao,Zhizheng Zhang,He Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一个用于机器人操作基础模型的交互与功能性物体组合生成框架（GIF），实现高质量的自动场景生成并提升生成物体之间功能结构的关系匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器人操作中的基础大模型需求可扩展性的评估和多样场景的数据生成，而自动化场景生成多关注于粗粒度布局，缺乏对细粒度功能性物体组合的研究。本论文针对这一不足提出解决方案。

Method: 提出了GIF生成框架，将场景生成问题分为独立实例重建（CoGen生成解耦网格和粗略位姿，结合2D/3D生成模型）、相对位姿优化（GPRM根据几何及物理约束优化相对姿态）、VLM验证器筛选最符合结构规范的生成结果。并构建包含8类接触-几何结构的评测基准，全面对比现有生成方法。

Result: GIF框架在资产质量及物体关系匹配方面优于现有先进生成器，碰撞率降低至1%以下。同时利用合成数据辅助策略学习，实验证明在仿真和真实部署中均实现多样性扩展。

Conclusion: GIF生成框架展现了在自动化生成复杂功能性场景中的领先性能，不仅提升了生成物体的结构功能匹配，还为数据驱动的机器人操作模型提供了强有力的数据基础。

Abstract: Robot manipulation foundation models require scalable evaluation and data generation across diverse scenarios, with simulation providing an environment for both. Automated scene generation offers a promising path, yet prior work has largely emphasized coarse-grained scene layouts rather than fine-grained functional object compositions. Motivated by this gap, we present GIF, an agentic Generation framework for Interactive and Functional object compositions. In this framework, we recast this problem as disentangled reconstruction followed by relative pose recovery. CoGen produces instance-disentangled meshes with coarse initial poses leveraging complementary strengths of 2D and 3D generative models. GPRM refines the relative pose under joint geometric and physical guidance, and a VLM verifier selects the candidate that best matches the structured specification. We further construct a benchmark spanning eight representative contact-geometry classes and compare with state-of-the-art generators; GIF improves both asset quality and relation matching, while reducing collision rate to below 1%. Finally, we synthesize data for policy learning, revealing diversity scaling in both simulation and real-world deployment.

</details>


### [476] [Moment-Matching Probabilistic Data Association for Optimization-Based SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05941)
*Khoa Nguyen,Mitchell Turton,Florian Meyer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将概率数据关联（PDA）方法引入优化型SLAM系统，提高多目标跟踪中的数据关联问题的处理能力，实验证明其可以提升定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化型SLAM常因周围环境复杂、数据关联不准等导致导航误差累积。多目标跟踪社区的PDA框架能解决多测量数据与地标关联不确定性问题。因此，作者希望通过结合PDA与优化型SLAM减少误差，提高可靠性。

Method: 在传统非线性最小二乘优化SLAM流程外，增加一个处理阶段：1）对每个地标以概率方式关联多个测量结果；2）通过多重关联进行矩匹配，计算地标的均值与协方差；3）引入虚拟地标观测及线性高斯测量模型，将PDA步骤转化为标准线性高斯更新，可嵌入任何优化型SLAM方法。

Result: 在包含误检测和假检测的仿真场景下，将PDA嵌入iSAM2后实验，结果显示定位性能优于原生iSAM2算法。

Conclusion: 将PDA与优化型SLAM结合能有效提升系统对数据关联不准时的鲁棒性和定位性能，为实际多目标、复杂环境的导航提供支持。

Abstract: Optimization-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) makes it possible to reduce accumulated navigation errors of sensing platforms by returning to known areas (loop closure). In this paper, we present an approach to combine probabilistic data association (PDA) with optimization-based SLAM. Instead of associating a single measurement with each landmark, we follow the PDA paradigm from the multiobject tracking community. In particular, in a processing stage performed in addition to the nonlinear least-squares solver of optimization-based SLAM, our method (i) assigns multiple measurements to landmarks probabilistically, (ii) computes the mean and covariance of landmark distributions via moment matching by taking multiple measurement-to-landmark associations into account, and (iii) establishes a virtual landmark measurement and a corresponding linear-Gaussian measurement model that leads to the mean and covariance matrix as moment-matching PDA in (ii). By converting the PDA update step into an equivalent linear-Gaussian measurement update step, PDA can be performed effectively within any optimization-based SLAM method. Our preliminary numerical evaluation in a scenario with false negatives and false positives indicates that incremental smoothing and mapping 2 (iSAM2), combined with the proposed PDA approach, can improve agent localization performance compared to conventional iSAM2.

</details>


### [477] [Observation Design for Certified Control Authority: Projection--Estimability Separation and Active-Face Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05962)
*Guangxi Wan,Hualong Du,Yuqi Liu,Qingwei Dong,Qingxin Li,Hongfei Bai,Peng Zeng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在运行时准入机制中，如何设计观测以最大化可安全通过的动作集合，揭示该问题与传统设计问题的本质不同，并提出了关于约束分解、最优观测设计和认证瓶颈的新理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运算时系统需保证只执行能被安全认证的动作，但如何以观测设计最大化这一动作集合尚未有系统研究。作者旨在明确观测设计与行动准入之间的关系，并推动相关理论进展。

Method: 作者提出了约束法向量的'投影-可估性'分解法，分析了不同分量对动作区分与认证的影响；基于线性规划与矩阵论，探究了具有最优辨别能力和最大准许性的观测设计，并给出了相关等价定理。利用Caratheodory论证，作者量化了瓶颈认证面数量，推导容量、曲率等理论界值。

Result: 论文证明了约束法向量不同分量影响认证能力的本质区别，明确了最优设计方案集中体现在法向量具有良好可观测性时。提出了'主动面等价定理'，说明最大准许可行设计与特定L最优设计等价，并给出了一般约束下各类最优设计的一致性与可证性界限。

Conclusion: 运行时准入的可认证范围严格受限于观测结构，通过结构性设计与分析可以显著扩大可安全动作集，并准确界定瓶颈与提升空间，给出理论与实际应用的具体指导。

Abstract: A sound runtime admission gate executes only actions it can certify, and certifies only what its observations support. This paper asks how observations should be designed to maximize the set of actions that can be safely admitted, and shows the question is not a re-vocabulary of classical design problems. First, a projection--estimability separation: decomposing a constraint normal as $c=c_{\mathrm{Range}}+c_{\ker}$ relative to an information matrix, two-point discrimination along $c$ becomes arbitrarily reliable as the budget grows whenever $c_{\mathrm{Range}}\neq 0$, while robust admission of an action with normal $c$ is impossible at every budget whenever $c_{\ker}\neq 0$; such mixed directions are generic at any deficient rank, and at full rank the decoupling is bounded by the Kantorovich ratio and diverges with the condition number. Discrimination-optimal designs, being corner solutions of a linear criterion, land in exactly this regime. Second, an active-face equivalence theorem: the permissiveness-optimal design is $L$-optimal for a target matrix generated endogenously by the action faces that become certification bottlenecks, weighted inversely by their remaining slack; single-face collapse recovers $c$-optimal and goal-oriented design exactly, and a Caratheodory argument yields a bottleneck certificate of at most $r(r+1)/2+1$ faces. Around these we assemble exact certifiability per convex contract mode, for which $κ\approx 3.29$ is derived rather than calibrated, the $\sqrt{r}$ price of contract-agnostic design, an information-to-slack transfer theorem with a curvature-budget corollary, and a two-part audit in which a design meeting every margin requirement still leaves an action face at a certification cost above ten times its testing cost, in every probe library tested.

</details>


### [478] [A Brain-inspired Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Robot Task Reasoning and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05985)
*Guangming Wang,Pengfei Ye,Qizhen Ying,Yixiong Jing,Yuxiang Ma,Haonan Chen,Haibing Wu,Olaf Wysocki,Molong Duan,Brian Sheil*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受人脑分工启发的零样本分层机器人控制框架，能更好地处理开放式语言指令下的复杂任务，将感知、推理、动作规划与执行验证有机结合，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前端到端视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）策略提高了不同任务间的泛化能力，但往往直接将视觉及语言输入映射为机器人动作，缺乏显式的结构化以支持长时任务分解、物理约束验证与过程中断恢复。现实场景下，指令执行需要更强的物理推理与中间状态监控。

Method: 提出了一个分层框架，包括：1）视觉感知与状态推理；2）语言指令解析并基于可复用原子动作库生成动作序列；3）基于执行成本对方案排序；4）机器人实际执行并基于新观测验证中间结果。每个任务通过明确的对象状态进行指令落地，组合原子动作生成条件化行动序列，并在每一步基于观测结果判断和恢复。

Result: 该方法在三个典型任务中表现优异，分别在clean board、pick-and-place和pyramid stacking任务中达到100%、100%和96.67%的平均任务完成度。对比ReKep、Dream2Flow和π_{0.5}等基线，成功率更高，验证了方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文框架通过引入显式对象状态推理、可组合原子动作、基于成本的计划筛选和闭环验证，显著提升了机器人语言指令执行的通用性、稳健性和灵活适应能力，对复杂长时任务具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Robots that follow open-ended language instructions need to connect semantic intent to visual scene understanding, geometric feasibility, object states, and physical interaction conditions. End-to-end Vision-Language-Action policies have improved cross-task generalization, but they typically map visual and language inputs directly to robot actions, leaving limited explicit structure for long-horizon decomposition, physical verification, and recovery. We present \method, a zero-shot hierarchical framework functionally inspired by the division of roles in the human brain, comprising visual perception and state inference, language grounding and action-sequence generation from a shared atomic action library, cost-based plan selection, and real-robot execution and verification. The framework grounds commands in explicit object states, composes reusable atomic actions into task-conditioned sequences, ranks alternative sequences by execution cost, and verifies intermediate physical outcomes from refreshed observations. In the evaluation, \method{} completes 10/10 clean board trials, 10/10 pick-and-place trials, and 4/5 pyramid stacking trials for both the flat and irregular initial-layout conditions; the corresponding mean task progress is $99.03\%$, $100.00\%$, and $96.67\%$ respectively. Across all evaluated conditions, \method{} achieves higher success rates than ReKep, Dream2Flow, and $π_{0.5}$ benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining explicit object-state reasoning, compositional atomic actions, cost-based plan selection, and closed-loop execution verification.

</details>


### [479] [GLoRI: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Tracking with Global-Local Reference Interaction for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05994)
*Qingyao Xu,Sheng Yin,Zibo Zhou,Ya Zhang,Siheng Chen,Yue Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为GLoRI的全身控制器，通过结合局部运动结构与全局位置校正，实现更高精度的人形机器人动作追踪与操控，可稳健泛化到真实机器人和多对象场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在跟踪时，要么只关注局部运动而忽略了绝对空间位置，导致累积全局误差；要么依赖全局信息但缺乏对局部运动的明确指导，限制了自主跟踪的准确性，因而需要一种既能结构化利用全局信息，又能很好保留局部动作结构的控制方法。

Method: 提出GLoRI全身控制器，通过GLoRI-Net神经网络引入Global-Local Cross Attention(GLCA)机制：利用全局目标和姿态差分特征精炼和修正局部关键点特征，实现运动结构的保持与全局位置误差的校正。系统在训练与推断均涉及闭环反馈，提升了控制精度和自动化水平。

Result: 在HuMoTo测试集上达到100%任务完成率与6.44cm的g-MPJPE。模型无需微调即可实现Isaac Gym到MuJoCo的直接迁移，展现了强泛化能力。在真实Unitree G1机器人上，该方法支持单策略完成对多种未知物体的自主操纵任务，超越以往依赖远程操作或单对象的系统。

Conclusion: GLoRI有效结合了全局参照与局部引导，极大提高了自主动作追踪和操控的准确性与泛化性，为人形机器人在复杂交互场景中的自主操作奠定了基础，显著推动了领域发展。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires accurate whole-body motion tracking in the world frame for physical interaction. While local references preserve motion structure, they lack explicit constraints on absolute spatial placement, leading to accumulated global errors. Existing globally aware approaches augment teleoperation policies with global observations but do not explicitly integrate global correction with local motion guidance, limiting autonomous tracking accuracy. We present GLoRI, a closed-loop whole-body controller that integrates structured global reference and feedback with local motion guidance. Its GLoRI-Net uses Global-Local Cross Attention(GLCA) to refine local keypoint features with global target and pose-difference features, preserving motion structure while correcting world-frame placement. GLoRI achieves 100% completion and a g-MPJPE of 6.44cm on held-out HuMoTo motions. This accuracy remains robust under direct Isaac Gym-to-MuJoCo transfer without fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization. Furthermore, such accuracy and generalization enable autonomous loco-manipulation with a single policy on a real Unitree G1 interacting with diverse unseen objects, extending beyond prior systems that primarily rely on teleoperation or focus on single-object interactions.

</details>


### [480] [How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06009)
*Jiaju Yin,Zhenhui Zhang,Lixin Xu,Heng Zhang,Jun Shao,Yating Feng,Arash Ajoudani,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合人为干预信号进行风险自适应的强化学习框架WHIRL，可以提升多指灵巧机械手的安全性与任务成功率，并有效减少人工干预的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多指灵巧手的强化学习受高维动作空间和硬件故障成本高影响，难以安全、高效地部署于真实环境。已有的人机混合强化学习方法未能充分利用人类主动干预中隐含的安全信息，往往只做反应性修正，忽略人类会主动回避风险区域的洞见。

Method: 作者提出WHIRL框架，将人为干预行为转化为前瞻性安全信号，在潜变量世界模型中引入一个创新的逐状态干预概率预测头，预测未来状态下人类接管的可能性，并以此结果用于风险调节，指导策略避免进入高风险区间。该框架在16自由度LEAP手及多种复杂操控任务（如抓取、位移、长程多阶段任务）上进行测试。

Result: WHIRL在复杂抓取任务中达到了96.7%的成功率，且在人机混合控制下，操作员干预需求在步权重指标上减少了84%。系统能够有效预测风险，自动回避需人为频繁干预的区域，减轻了操作员负担。

Conclusion: 通过将人类对风险的感知与前瞻性世界建模结合，WHIRL为现实多指灵巧手的安全高效强化学习提供了切实可行的范例，有助于减少操作员疲劳和硬件损耗，推动了此领域实际落地的可行性。

Abstract: Multi-fingered dexterous manipulation remains a frontier for real-world reinforcement learning (RL) due to the high-dimensional action space and the prohibitive cost of hardware failures. While human-in-the-loop (HIL) RL allows operators to intervene before failures occur, current pipelines often treat these interventions as reactive corrections, discarding the rich safety signal inherent in the operator's decision to take control. In this paper, we ask: How can we learn from what a human would avoid? We present WHIRL, a safety-aware RL framework that transforms binary human interventions into forward-predictive signals for proactive risk avoidance. Our approach centers on an intervention-aware latent world model with four prediction heads: dynamics, reward, termination, and a novel per-state intervention-probability head that learns to predict the likelihood of a human takeover at future states. This head provides an actor-side risk-shaping term that discourages the policy from entering "intervention-prone" regions, modeling the operator's internal safety threshold. We evaluate our framework on a 16-DoF LEAP Hand across tasks spanning convex and irregular object grasping, prismatic manipulation, and long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Our results show that predictive risk-shaping enables the system to achieve a 96.7 percent success rate on complex grasping tasks while reducing the operator intervention burden by up to 84 percent in step-weighted terms. By closing the loop between human intuition and predictive world modeling, this work provides a practical safety-aware recipe for training complex dexterous agents in the real world while reducing operator fatigue and hardware-risk exposure.

</details>


### [481] [FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06046)
*Matteo El Hariry,Pedro Lima,Andrej Orsula,Matthieu Geist,Miguel Olivares-Mendez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个高保真、模块化的固定翼近地飞行机器人仿真框架，可用于开发与评估飞行控制策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有固定翼飞行器仿真器大多采用简化或仅适合悬停状态的动力学建模，不能真实反映近地飞行复杂环境下的控制需求。因此，需要更物理真实的仿真环境以支持实际应用和算法开发。

Method: 该框架实现了完整的6自由度刚体物理建模、半经验地面效应空气动力学、执行机构动力学、传感器噪声及环境干扰等。通过模块化组件设计，支持基于Torch与NVIDIA Warp的CPU和GPU并行高吞吐仿真，便于大规模强化学习或最优控制策略训练。统一接口兼容多种控制算法和典型任务，并可与X-Plane和JSBSim交叉验证以提升工程适配性和视觉真实感。

Result: 所开发仿真器能在高物理真实性下，系统化分析低空飞行行为，并支持多算法、多任务的对比测试与大规模训练。提升了仿真的灵活性和工程实用性。

Conclusion: 新框架为近地固定翼飞行控制策略的开发与基准测试提供了可靠、灵活、高效的支撑，有助于推动相关领域算法与工程应用发展。

Abstract: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under realistic conditions. The simulator supports both CPU and GPU backends via Torch and NVIDIA Warp, enabling high-throughput parallel execution suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control rollouts. A unified interface accommodates a range of controllers (both RL and optical control algorithms) across tasks such as altitude regulation and trajectory tracking. Cross-validation with X-Plane and JSBSim is also supported to facilitate engineering integration and visual fidelity.

</details>


### [482] [SCoCaT: Success Conditioned Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Spacecraft Docking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06061)
*Aman Arora,Ricard Marsal I Castan,Matteo El-Hariry,Miguel Olivares-Mendez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文分析了基于终止的约束强化学习方法存在结构性失败，并提出了简单有效的增强方式来解决此问题，提升了任务完成率且不牺牲安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键型机器人任务需要约束强化学习在保证安全的前提下实现目标。传统基于终止的约束方法在推理时避免了复杂优化、实现简单，且易于多约束扩展，但其在任务终点附近对约束过度强调，导致难以完成任务。

Method: 文章首先理论化了该方法在终端导航任务中的缺陷：当目标接近不可行区域边界时，智能体倾向于避免进入目标区域以维持约束合规，从而降低任务完成率。针对这一点，作者建议对现有RL（如PPO）做最小化增强——引入辅助价值评估器，给予每步成功信号（dense per-step success signal），鼓励智能体持续朝向目标区域推进。

Result: 实验证明，该方法能够显著提升任务完成率，同时保持高安全约束合规性。具体在两个有代表性的航天器平台（6U-CubeSat及实验室仿真平台）上验证，涵盖了复杂操作环境和现实迁移。

Conclusion: 基于终止的约束强化学习面临可行性崩溃问题。通过简单引入辅助奖励信号和价值评估，可以有效缓解并提升实际部署表现，具备在复杂安全场景下的普适性与实用价值。

Abstract: Termination-based constrained reinforcement learning is attractive for safety-critical robotic deployments: it avoids online optimization at inference, scales easily to many constraints via a single scalar per constraint, and is simpler to implement than commonly used Lagrangian methods. Instead of pricing violations through summed cost penalties, this approach makes violations structurally unprofitable by shortening the effective horizon for each violation. We identify a structural failure mode of this method class on terminal-navigation tasks: reaching a precise goal configuration while satisfying safety constraints that tighten along the final approach. When the goal sits inside the region close to where the constraints become active, the survival-weighted objective makes dwelling outside the goal region strictly preferable to entering, producing high constraint compliance with low task completion. We formalize this pathology and show that a minimal augmentation to off-the-shelf RL algorithms like PPO resolves this ``feasibility collapse''. We empirically demonstrate that adding a dense per-step success signal via an auxiliary value critic improves the task completion rate while maintaining safety-critical constraint compliance. Validation across two representative spacecraft platforms: a 6U-CubeSat spanning the mass and degree-of-freedom envelope of operational proximity operations, and a floating platform testbed for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in our laboratory, supports the generality of these findings.

</details>


### [483] [Where Success Breaks: Failure-Boundary Learning for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06114)
*Yanzhe Chen,Zhijun Cao,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的方法DLS，用于提升视觉-语言-动作模型对失败边界的辨识和鲁棒性，相较于传统监督微调与强化学习方法效果更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SFT方法只学到成功行为，没有教会模型何处会失败，导致模型在未知情况不够鲁棒。需要一种能准确识别和调整成功与失败边界的方法。

Method: 提出Failure-Boundary Learning视角，将VLA适应问题转化为发现、定位和塑造任务失败边界。DLS方法利用少量真实演示和大量模拟协同训练，通过数字孪生回放大规模自动发现失败边界。创新地引入语义化的进度定位信号，而非简单二元标签，并通过定向边界塑造提升模型在成功与失败边界的辨识能力。

Result: 在真实机器人操作任务中，DLS在多种初始状态和未见视觉条件下均显著提升了鲁棒性，优于SFT和在线强化学习基线。

Conclusion: DLS方法能有效发现和塑造成功与失败行为的分界，提高VLA模型在多变环境下的鲁棒性，为未来类任务带来更可靠的适应能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapted through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) inherit a structural asymmetry: expert demonstrations teach the policy where success behavior lies, but provide no signal about where it ceases to be reliable. We argue that robust VLA adaptation should therefore be viewed not as further demonstration fitting, but as **Failure-Boundary Learning**---the problem of *Discovering*, *Localizing*, and *Shaping* the boundary between recoverable deviations and task failure. To instantiate this view, we propose **DLS**: built on a **real-grounded behavioral prior** from few real demonstrations and simulated co-training, DLS *discovers* failure boundaries at scale through on-policy digital twin rollouts. Rather than reducing each rollout to a binary label, **semantic progress localization** uses privileged simulator states to assign progress-aware signals that capture *where* the failure boundary is crossed, not merely *whether*. These signals drive **directional boundary shaping** in the flow dynamics---reinforcing success-producing denoising directions and suppressing failure-producing ones, without action likelihoods or auxiliary critics. Across real-robot manipulation tasks, DLS improves robustness over SFT and online RL baselines, especially under randomized initial states and unseen visual conditions.

</details>


### [484] [RefGuard: Identity-Aware Language-Guided Robot Manipulation via Joint Target-Anchor-Frame Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06221)
*Lan Wei,Kangyi Lu,Yongchen Wang,Chenmeng Bi,Qi Chen,Hanlin Niu,Yip Fun Yeung,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RefGuard方法，有效减少视觉-语言-动作模型中物体身份切换错误，大幅提升机器人在多义性情境下准确执行指令的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人操作中，难以精确判别指令所指物体，尤其是在杂乱、重复物体等多义场景中容易发生身份切换（identity switch）错误，直接影响操作的可靠性和正确性。

Method: 提出RefGuard，一种身份感知的指代消解框架：基于RGB-D观测，构建以对象为中心、具备参考系条件的场景图，将物体几何信息与方向关系分离；通过维护目标、锚点与参考框架三变量的联合后验分布，推迟决策直至不确定性显著降低。此外，决策策略可执行、澄清、再观察或终止任务，以避免不可逆转的错误。

Result: 在实际机械臂UF850和3200轮程序化任务测试中，RefGuard在多义性挑战下0次发生身份切换，正确执行率达90%；而对比VLA和大型语言模型基线身份切换率为33-46%；在无歧义场景保持93.3%成功率，在参考解析后场景变化时有86.7%的恢复率。在程序化任务中，正确执行率由56.6%提高至80.5%，推迟决策频率降低。

Conclusion: RefGuard能有效缓解复杂多义环境下机器人身份切换问题，提高操作安全性和准确率，展示了多变量联合后验与延迟决策在机器人指令执行中的重大价值。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have substantially advanced language-guided robot manipulation, yet reliable execution still hinges on identifying which physical object an instruction refers to. In cluttered scenes containing repeated objects, ambiguous anchors, or frame-dependent spatial terms, a robot can execute a geometrically valid action on a semantically compatible but unintended instance; we call this failure an identity switch. The referent is jointly determined by three coupled latent variables: the target, the anchor, and the reference frame, so committing to any one of them before execution turns residual ambiguity into a silent and irreversible error. We propose RefGuard, an identity-aware grounding framework that delays commitment by maintaining a joint posterior over all three variables. RefGuard builds a frame-conditioned object-centric scene graph from RGB-D observations, separating frame-independent geometry from directional relations, and routes the posterior through a decision policy that executes, clarifies, reobserves, or aborts. On a real UF850 arm, RefGuard records no identity switch on any ambiguity-stress trial and executes correctly on 90.0% of them, whereas fine-tuned VLA and LLM (Large Language Model)-based baselines switch identity in 33-46% of the same trials, while retaining 93.3% success on unambiguous scenes and recovering from post-grounding scene changes in 86.7% of trials. On a 3200-episode procedural suite, it raises correct execution on solvable instructions from 56.6% to 80.5% over the ablation that commits to the anchor and frame before the target, while deferring less often (19.5% vs. 43.4%).

</details>


### [485] [GloVLA: Let Geometry Move and Local VLA Interact for Robust Object-Centric Manipulation in Unstructured Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06256)
*Truong Thanh Nguyen,Huy Hoang Nguyen,Ha Anh Nguyen,Binh Khanh Dinh,Ngo Anh Vien,Duy Nguyen Ho Minh,Minh Nhat Vu,Ngan Le*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GloVLA框架通过将物体操作过程显式分为几何转运和局部精细操作两部分，有效提升了机器人在复杂环境下的任务成功率和推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在语言指导下的机器人操作任务中泛化能力有限，尤其面对复杂环境时易受扰动影响导致失败，原因在于单一策略需同时解决长距离移动和精细交互，效率低且不鲁棒。

Method: 提出GloVLA，将物体操作任务分解为两个阶段：1)利用几何转运控制器先把末端执行器移动到目标区域；2)通过局部VLA策略完成短时的精细交互。接口友好、无需新增数据，且适配多种VLA模型。

Result: 在标准LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus任务及新增的LIBERO-Challenge基准测试中，GloVLA在遮挡、杂乱、光照变化等情况下均显著提升了任务成功率。例如，复杂环境下原始端到端策略成功率降至20.9%，GloVLA保有88.5%；实物测试成功率由35.6%提升到90.0%，且推理时间减半。

Conclusion: GloVLA通过“分而治之”的规划与控制范式，大幅增强了VLA在复杂真实场景中的可靠性和效率，在无需额外演示和结构修改的条件下拓展了VLA的实际部署能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promising generalization for language-conditioned robot manipulation, but deploying them in unstructured environments remains challenging. A single end-to-end VLA policy must simultaneously solve long-range transport of the end effector to task-relevant regions and short-horizon, contact-rich interaction upon arrival. This formulation is inefficient and brittle: small visual shifts, distractors, clutter, occlusions, or unfavorable initial gripper poses can push the policy outside the local state distribution in which it was trained, leading to task failure. We introduce GloVLA, a hybrid framework that explicitly separates object-centric manipulation into two complementary regimes: a geometric transport controller moves the end-effector into interaction-centric handoff regions, and local VLA policies handle only the short-horizon interaction phases. GloVLA is model-agnostic and can be integrated with different VLA backbones with no additional demonstrations and no changes to the action space or success predicate. Experiments on standard LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus Object tasks together with a newly introduced LIBERO-Challenge benchmark ettings with clutter, distractors,illumination changes, visual shifts, and obstruction show that GloVLA improves task success and substantially lowers VLA inference cost compared with full end-to-Challenge, full-trajectory GR00T N1.6execution degrades to 20.9% average success while GloVLA retains 88.5%; on a physical UR10e, overall success improves from 35.6% to 90.0% while mean inference time is more than halved. Videos and additional results are available at https://glovla-project.github.io/

</details>


### [486] [Bundle Length Tradeoffs in Decentralized Multi-Robot Task Allocation Under Degraded Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06273)
*James Lott,Vahraz Honary*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文系统研究了多任务多机器人任务分配(MRTA)中bundle length（任务包长度）对MinSum和MinMax分配目标的影响，并分析了在通信丢包情形下最优bundle length的转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往MRTA研究中，bundle length常常被固定设置，且优化目标（MinSum或MinMax）对任务分配有不同偏向，但bundle length在此目标权衡中的作用未被系统表征。此外，现实通信容易发生丢包，但往往沿用理想通信场景下的bundle设置，易导致性能下降。

Method: 本文基于ACBBA、PI和HIPC三种分配算法，在六种不同bundle length、300组10目标协同访问任务下，分别在理想通信和25%伯努利丢包场景进行配对实验，并采用交叉检验分析性能。

Result: 在理想通信下，bundle length从1到12，三种算法的MinSum成本降低幅度为19.0%-31.8%，但MinMax成本大幅增加45.6%-94.3%。在25%丢包下，A和PI算法的最佳MinSum设置由12变为2，若不调整，则MinSum和MinMax成本分别恶化7.2%-14.4%和30.0%-41.8%。

Conclusion: bundle length对MRTA目标优化有显著影响，且在通信丢包条件下，需要重新调优bundle length，否则分配性能损失明显。不同算法对bundle长度适应性不同，HIPC在丢包下表现较为稳定。

Abstract: Bundle length B is commonly fixed when configuring multi-task multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) algorithms. MinSum and MinMax are known to favor different task distributions, but the role of B in this objective tradeoff has not been systematically characterized. Additionally, degraded-communication evaluations also often retain settings selected under ideal communication, leaving whether nominal bundle-length tuning transfers under message loss unresolved. We examine both questions for ACBBA, PI, and HIPC across six bundle lengths in 300 paired ten-target Collaborative Visit scenarios under ideal communication and 25% Bernoulli packet loss. Under ideal communication, increasing B from 1 to 12 reduces MinSum cost by 19.0%, 23.0%, and 31.8% for ACBBA, PI, and HIPC, respectively, while increasing MinMax cost by 45.6%, 94.3%, and 67.6%. Under packet loss, the lowest-mean MinSum setting shifts from B = 12 to B = 2 for ACBBA and PI. Repeated paired cross-fitting shows that retaining the ideal-network setting incurs held-out MinSum penalties of 14.4% and 7.2%, respectively, and increases MinMax cost by 30.0% and 41.8% relative to the loss-conditioned MinSum setting. HIPC retains a deep MinSum operating region, while the MinMax setting remains stable for all three allocators. Experiments at two additional target loads reproduce the ACBBA and PI MinSum shifts.

</details>


### [487] [IM-ENGINE: Image Editing for Embodied Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06279)
*Yian Wang,Junyi Cao,Xiaowen Qiu,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出IM-ENGINE，通过图像编辑作为中间表示，结合仿真与语义注入，实现可扩展且符合任务需求的机器人操作监督数据生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器人学习数据获取难以同时满足‘语义上有意义’和‘物理上可执行’两个条件。人工示范数据成本高且受实体差异限制，仿真自动生成又常遗漏关键语义。

Method: IM-ENGINE将图像编辑作为中间步骤：在已知场景几何、深度、分割等基础上编辑图片，注入任务相关语义，然后借助仿真器先验及不变锚点，还原显式3D状态，经物理仿真细化，最终得到可供机器人执行的监督信号。该方法可应用于灵巧抓取和目标生成任务，例如，先在人手图像空间生成抓取，然后还原交互，重定位到机器人手，再物理约束下优化出有效抓取策略。

Result: IM-ENGINE 能自动生成既符合物理规律又具丰富语义监督的数据，例如生成合理的人手与物体交互姿态并转换为机器人抓取动作，同时可以编辑场景图像以指定目标结果，从而推导出切实可行的目标状态和轨迹。

Conclusion: IM-ENGINE实现了仿真与语义先验的高效结合，为机器人学习提供大规模、语义性强且物理可执行的任务相关监督。

Abstract: Learning-based manipulation requires supervision that is both semantically meaningful and physically executable, but current data pipelines often provide only one of these properties. Human demonstrations capture intent but are costly to collect and constrained by the human-robot embodiment gap, while simulation can scale data generation but often under-specifies functional behavior. We present IM-ENGINE, a simulator-grounded pipeline that uses image editing as an intermediate representation for embodied data generation. Given a rendered scene with known geometry, depth, segmentation, and camera parameters, IM-ENGINE edits the image to inject task-relevant semantics, recovers explicit 3D state using simulator priors and an unchanged anchor object, refines the state in physics, and converts it into robot-executable supervision. We instantiate the pipeline for dexterous grasp synthesis and goal-state generation. For grasping, IM-ENGINE generates a human grasp in image space, recovers the hand-object interaction, retargets it to a robot hand, and refines it into physically validated robot grasps. For goal generation, it edits a rendered scene into a desired outcome, recovers the target-object pose, and refines it into physically valid, semantically meaningful goals and trajectories. This combination of generative semantic priors and simulator grounding enables scalable task-relevant supervision for robot learning.

</details>


### [488] [Geometric Distributional Control: Learning Progress with Partial Structural Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06331)
*Tong Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Geometric Distributional Control (GDC)，专为部分已知系统（如自动驾驶、仓库机器人等）设计，将控制分为可行性与进展两个部分，兼具已知模型与学习方法的优点，在保证可行性的基础上高效学习任务推进策略，实验表明优于已知方法和强化学习基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统中通常只有部分动力学、规则或约束已知，传统模型控制方法要求完整知识，而强化学习虽可应对未知但训练成本高且效果不稳定。迫切需要能利用部分知识同时高效学习任务推进的方法。

Method: GDC方法将控制问题分为：1）基于已知几何、规则、约束等构建可行性框架；2）在该框架下，只学习推进任务的局部信号（不用全局值函数），采用短可行轨迹和弱任务进展证据进行分布拟合，并利用该分数函数进行实时反馈控制。无需完整动力学或长时规划。

Result: 在多层次优化任务和SUMO自动驾驶测试中，GDC比仅依赖已知规则的优化器和标准强化学习基线都表现更好，并保证动作始终满足已知的可行性/约束条件。

Conclusion: GDC结合了模型知识和数据驱动学习的优势，在结构部分已知的实际问题中既保证策略合规，又提升任务效率，是现有纯模型或纯学习方法优良的补充和改进。

Abstract: Real-time control often sits between two limiting regimes. Predictive optimization and model-based control are powerful when dynamics, parameters, objectives, and online planning models are specified; reinforcement learning can relax this requirement, but must infer long-horizon value signals from sequential data and interaction, making training slow, high-variance, and hard to scale in large action spaces. This middle regime is common in systems including autonomous driving, warehouse robotics, traffic control, and delivery drones: partial geometry, physics, rules, or constraints are known, yet the local direction of task progress remains uncertain. Geometric Distributional Control (GDC) is designed for this partial-knowledge setting. It factorizes control into feasibility and progress: known geometry, rules, constraints, and response maps define an executable scaffold, while progress-weighted feasible data learns the missing directional signal on that scaffold. The learned score acts as a Bellman-like local value-gradient, selecting actions that make progress without requiring global Bellman recursion, a fully specified planner, or a black-box policy that absorbs both feasibility and preference. This knowledge can be lightweight and partial, such as simple dynamics, safety filters, local maps, constraint projectors, or lower-level response maps; it need not encode full dynamics or a long-horizon objective. Offline, GDC fits a progress-tilted distribution from short known-feasible snippets with weak signed progress certificates. Online, its score is projected through the scaffold and applied in receding-horizon feedback. We prove that this score descends a data-induced soft progress value and validate GDC on structured multilevel optimization and SUMO route-progress driving, where it improves over known-only solvers and learning baselines while preserving scaffold-enforced feasibility.

</details>


### [489] [OcclusionCBF: Backup Control Barrier Functions for Safe Navigation Among Hidden Dynamic Obstacles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06342)
*Taekyung Kim,Hun Kuk Park,Renya Wada,Nikolay Atanasov,Shumon Koga,Dimitra Panagou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为OcclusionCBF的新型安全滤波方法，能让机器人在视野受遮挡情况下更安全地避让动态障碍物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际环境中，机器人面临动态障碍物经常被遮挡，现有方法在障碍物出现时可能来不及规避，导致碰撞。因此需要对遮挡下的安全导航进行更有效的研究。

Method: 提出了OcclusionCBF方法，将backup控制障碍函数扩展到对潜在遮挡动态障碍的可达占据预测，通过判定回滚轨迹与膨胀后占据区及终端安全集的关系，形成线性约束，实现了低侵入性的二次规划安全滤波器。

Result: 理论上证明了方法的递归可行性，并能在可预测占据内对所有隐藏障碍物运动实现无碰撞。通过随机基准、仿真（MetaUrban）和硬件实验，结果显示与反应式及其它预测基线相比，任务成功率明显提高，且计算时间极短。

Conclusion: OcclusionCBF能够显著提升机器人在视觉遮挡环境中的安全导航性能，兼具高效率和优越的实验表现，适用于实际复杂场景。

Abstract: Robots navigating under occlusion may enter states from which no admissible input can avoid a dynamic obstacle once it becomes visible. We present OcclusionCBF, a safety filter that extends backup control barrier functions to reachable-occupancy predictions for potentially hidden dynamic obstacles in occluded regions. The method certifies a prescribed backup rollout against collision-inflated occupancy and a verified terminal set, yielding affine constraints for minimally invasive quadratic-program filtering. We establish recursive feasibility of the resulting safety filter, and collision avoidance for every hidden-obstacle motion covered by the occupancy prediction. Randomized benchmarks, MetaUrban simulations, and hardware experiments demonstrate improved task success over reactive and occlusion-aware predictive baselines with millisecond-scale computation.

</details>


### [490] [LANTERN: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for VLM-Based Cooperative Driving with Temporally Grounded Warnings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06368)
*Yongshuo Liu,Xu Gao,Morui Zhu,Yongqi Zhu,Qi Chen,Deyuan Qu,Song Fu,Qing Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了LANTERN，一个用于时间相关的协作预警系统的闭环评测基准，并通过大量实验数据和创新评分体系，验证了协作预警对提高自动驾驶安全与表现的重要作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动驾驶及类似安全关键场景中，协作预警对于提升系统安全性非常关键，但评测预警贡献时常被视觉等其他传感器能力干扰，缺乏独立、细致的评测框架。作者希望发展一个能隔离并定量评测协作预警效用的标准化基准。

Method: LANTERN基准将警告发生、危险发生、警告终止和事后恢复等环节区分开，在同一路线下分别测试有预警和无预警，从而独立量化预警贡献。包含6类安全关键场景，提供3272条训练序列和120对评测路线，并新引入CUS综合评分指标，覆盖进展、预判、清障和恢复等多方面。

Result: 用典型的视觉语言驾驶模型微调实验，CUS（合作统一分）由无预警状态下的34.6提升至有预警下的75.5，证实协作预警对安全和表现的重要提升作用，并验证了基准和评分体系的判别力。

Conclusion: LANTERN提供了客观、细致的协作预警评测基准，并通过创新评分方法和实验验证，推动了协作预警领域的发展，所有相关资源将公开。

Abstract: We present LANTERN, a closed-loop benchmark for temporally grounded cooperative warnings. LANTERN separates warning onset, hazard onset, warning termination, and post-hazard recovery, and evaluates each physical event under matched warning and no-warning executions so that the warning's contribution is measured in isolation rather than confounded with onboard vision. The benchmark spans six safety-critical scenario families and provides 3,272 sequences with 236,309 frames for training, together with 120 matched route pairs for closed-loop evaluation. Each hazard route is evaluated under the warning and no-warning conditions, while its no-hazard control penalizes unconditional braking. We further introduce the Cooperative Unified Score (CUS), a safety-gated metric that jointly rewards route progress, anticipation, clearance, and recovery. Fine-tuning a representative VLM driving model raises CUS from 34.6 without warnings to 75.5 with them, demonstrating both the value of cooperative warnings and the discriminative power of the paired protocol. All resources will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [491] [OVMAN: A Task and Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Motion-Aware Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06424)
*Dibyendu Ghosh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OVMAN提出了一项新任务：在家居环境经过变化后，机器人需要根据变化本身来导航到目标位置，比现有基准更贴近真实生活中的导航需求。实验发现，目前主流方法在这种任务下表现较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人导航基准无法测试机器理解和应对场景中物体因变动而带来的变化目标，例如“去椅子原来在的位置”等。这种场景在真实家庭环境中非常常见。

Method: 作者提出OVMAN任务，要求机器人在场景发生变化后，依据物体变化本身来导航至相应位置。数据集中包含219个经过认证的两次访问场景。测试多种导航和记忆系统，包括零样本和开放词汇地图的方法。

Result: 传统的零样本导航器在以变化定义的目标上表现极差，尤其是针对“消失位置”；开放词汇地图系统答复过去时查询的成功率不到三分之一；参考体代理仅实现45.2%的成功率，远低于理论上（oracle）99.5%。

Conclusion: 主要难点在于开放词汇实例的绑定（grounding）而非单纯的几何推理或目标选择。现有主流方法难以胜任基于变化的导航任务，需进一步关注实例理解和记忆能力。

Abstract: Homes change between a robot's visits. Navigation benchmarks pose their goals in the world the agent currently sees, and the two-visit benchmarks that exist score recall or rearrangement rather than navigation. None of them can express go to the chair that was moved or go to where the vase used to be. OVMAN is a task in which an agent tours a scene, returns after a scripted change, and must navigate to a goal specified by the change itself. Two of its six change relations answer with a place an object has left, where nothing remains to be detected. We release 219 two-visit episodes, each certified solvable by an oracle agent that completes it three times. Two released systems fail as predicted. A zero-shot object-goal navigator reaches the change-defined target in 11.4% of episodes and essentially fails at vacated locations, 0.000 on former and 0.025 on removed. A self-maintaining open-vocabulary map answers past-tense queries at about a third of the rate of the same maps read as two visits, even when grounding is supplied. A simple two-visit reference agent reaches 45.2% when navigating, against an embodied oracle of 99.5%. An error decomposition places the remaining difficulty in open-vocabulary instance grounding rather than in geometry or in selecting the answer once positions are known.

</details>


### [492] [Collision Snapshot Guided Time-Reversed Safety-Critical Scenario Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06433)
*Taehyung Kim,Jongeun Choi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: COSTER是一种用于生成安全关键交通场景的新方法，能够更合理、多样地生成用于自动驾驶的训练和评估数据，并显著提升训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生成安全关键交通场景的方法主要通过扰动现有交通参与者的轨迹，生成对抗性的互动场景，但这样的方法生成的场景可信度和多样性有限。尽管可以通过插入新车辆改善上述问题，但何时何地插入车辆仍是一大挑战。

Method: 作者提出COSTER框架，利用学习得到的交通先验信息，确定合理的碰撞时间和位置。方法步骤为：1）在目标车辆附近插入新车辆，构建碰撞快照；2）从碰撞快照出发，利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）反向回滚新车辆轨迹，生成合理的场景过程。

Result: 实验证明，COSTER在场景的合理性、多样性及数据使用效率方面优于已有方法。基于COSTER生成场景训练的自动驾驶系统，在应对Waymo Open Motion Dataset中的安全关键场景时，碰撞率下降31%，任务完成率也有提升。

Conclusion: COSTER方法显著提升了交通场景生成的质量和效率，可有效用于自动驾驶系统的训练与评测，有助于提高安全性和实用性。

Abstract: The generation of safety-critical traffic scenarios is essential for training and evaluating autonomous vehicles. Prior approaches typically perturb the trajectories of existing agents in a traffic scenario using simplified adversarial objectives to induce safety-critical interactions, which can limit the plausibility and diversity of the generated scenarios. Although inserting new adversarial vehicles can alleviate this limitation, determining when and where to introduce them in a scenario-specific manner remains challenging. In this work, we introduce \underline{CO}llision \underline{S}napshot guided \underline{T}im\underline{E}-\underline{R}eversed safety-critical scenario generation (COSTER), a framework that leverages learned traffic priors to determine plausible collision times and locations. COSTER first constructs a collision snapshot by inserting a new vehicle in contact with the target vehicle at the identified collision state within a traffic scenario. Starting from this collision snapshot, a conditional variational autoencoder is used to perform a time-reversed rollout, reconstructing the trajectory of the inserted vehicle backward toward earlier timesteps. Experiments show that COSTER outperforms existing methods in plausibility, diversity, and data efficiency. Moreover, agents trained on COSTER-generated scenarios reduce collision rates by 31\% on safety-critical scenarios from the Waymo Open Motion Dataset while also improving ego task completion. The project website is available at https://anonym-121.github.io/COSTER/.

</details>


### [493] [\textbf{PLATO}: \emph{Preintegration Learning from Accurate Trajectory Observations} for Neural Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06450)
*Haoying Li,Qihang Liu,Yifan Peng,Keyan Miao,Junfeng Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的惯性测程预积分方法PLATO，通过深度神经网络和概率建模，提高了对IMU偏置和噪声的学习能力，并在多种场景下验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惯性测程在复杂环境下表现优秀，但传统预积分对IMU偏置和噪声不敏感，易导致误差积累。这需要新的方法更好地建模和校正这些不确定性。

Method: PLATO框架基于轨迹观测及似然最大化思想，采用神经常微分方程（NODE）建模IMU偏置动态，联合优化陀螺仪和加速度计噪声参数。通过前向微分和设计的双重伴随反向传播机制，实现高效的似然优化。

Result: 在EuRoC数据集上取得了比传统方法更好的定位精度，在水下机器人等极端视觉退化环境中也验证了其普适性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PLATO有效提升了惯性测程在有偏置和噪声不确定条件下的性能，适用于不同场景，具有广泛应用前景。

Abstract: Neural inertial odometry has demonstrated strong potential for motion estimation in challenging environments, yet inertial-only preintegration remains sensitive to IMU bias and uncertainty. To this end, this paper introduces \textbf{PLATO}:~\emph{Preintegration Learning from Accurate Trajectory Observations}, a likelihood-based framework that leverages accurate trajectory observations to jointly learn IMU bias dynamics modeled by a neural ordinary differential equation~(NODE) and gyroscope and accelerometer noise covariances. Optimization exploits the sparse structure of the negative log-likelihood, with IMU noise-parameter gradients computed by forward differentiation. A tailored double-adjoint scheme couples a discrete invariant-error adjoint with a continuous-time adjoint for the bias NODE, enabling memory-efficient likelihood optimization over the nested bias-dynamics and IMU-preintegration rollouts. Validation on EuRoC shows improved performance, and underwater robot experiments demonstrate applicability under intermittent lighting failures and visual degradation.

</details>


### [494] [VLA-Corrector: Stage-Aware Observable State Understanding for Prompt-Based Closed-Loop Recovery of Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06508)
*Chang Song,Bin Qian,Yan Feng,Zhijie Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的闭环纠错框架，通过引入历史观测的学习判别器和阶段化恢复提示，显著提升了机器人长时序操作在多种干扰下的鲁棒性，无需参数更新或特权信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在长时序操作中容易受到动作噪声、目标偏移等影响，最终的任务成功率很难定位和校正失败原因，缺乏有效闭环恢复机制。

Method: 提出一个基于观测历史的学习判别器，联合建模多视角视觉、机器人本体状态和执行动作，对操作进展和风险评估。执行流程被分为关键语义阶段（如靠近、对齐、抓取、运输、放置等），在检测到异常后，保持原始任务指令，根据出错阶段生成恢复提示，利用不变的VLA策略产生纠正动作。

Result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO Plus等多轮评测中，所提方法在无特权信息情况下实现了接近特权规则基础的恢复效果，有效提高了执行鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 视觉-本体-动作的历史观测足以推断潜在任务状态，实现VLA策略下低成本、泛化性强的闭环恢复，提高了实际机器人操作系统的性能和实用性。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remains vulnerable to execution-time deviations, as final task success provides little information for diagnosing and correcting failures caused by action noise, object displacement, or goal misalignment. We introduce a stage-aware failure verification and Prompt Recovery framework that enables closed-loop correction of a fixed VLA policy without parameter updates or privileged simulator states. The framework introduces an observable-history-based Learned Verifier that jointly estimates manipulation progress and execution risk by temporally modeling multi-view visual observations, proprioceptive states, and executed actions. To provide interpretable task understanding, we represent manipulation execution through semantic progress stages, including approach, alignment, grasp, transport, and placement, and identify stage-specific failure patterns. Upon detecting abnormal execution, the framework preserves the original instruction and generates a stage-conditioned recovery prompt, allowing the same frozen VLA policy to produce corrective actions. Extensive multi-round evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO Plus demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves closed-loop reliability under diverse perturbations. Without access to privileged object or goal coordinates, the Learned Verifier achieves recovery performance close to that of the privileged rule-based verifier in the evaluated settings. These results show that observable visual-proprioceptive-action history is sufficient to infer latent task states and enable practical failure recovery for existing VLA policies.

</details>


### [495] [Knowledge-Guided Hierarchical Policy Learning for High-Precision Cylindrical Assembly under Tight Tolerances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06522)
*Binbin Lian,Xinyu Liu,Tao Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种混合分层学习框架，实现高精度组装，兼顾专家经验和端到端学习，仿真到现实迁移，并验证鲁棒性与高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提高170mm圆柱形部件（公差0.1mm）组装的精准度和鲁棒性，解决机器人在实际复杂环境下对初始状态和噪声敏感的问题。

Method: 下层网络结合行为克隆(BC)引入专家经验，加用TD3算法增强训练稳定性与鲁棒性；上层网络依据启发式规则动态调整下层决策。先在仿真中学习，再迁移到实际机器人系统。

Result: 奖励在500个回合内收敛，学习效率高，适应各种初始条件和姿态误差，在极端条件下也能保持较高成功率；面对高斯噪声时表现出良好的稳定性。实机运动轨迹更加平滑、波动更小。

Conclusion: 该混合分层框架有效提升了机器人高精度组装任务的效率、成功率和鲁棒性，适用于实际复杂制造场景。

Abstract: A hybrid hierarchical learning framework is proposed to achieve high-precision assembly of 170mm cylindrical components with tolerance of 0.1mm. The lower-level network integrates expert experience through Behavior Cloning (BC), giving the robot human-like intuition, and incorporates the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm to enhance training stability and robustness. The upper-level network dynamically adjusts the lower-level decisions based on heuristic rules, ensuring flexibility in operations. A simulated model is constructed to learn before transferring to real world. An efficient and safe training is allowed. Comparisons show that the reward curve converges within 500 episodes, indicating high learning efficiency. It also demonstrates better adaptability to initial conditions and pose errors, achieving satisfactory success rates even under extreme conditions. Moreover, the method exhibits good stability under Gaussian noise interference. In the real world, the assembly trajectory of the cylindrical segment shows smoother motion and less fluctuation.

</details>


### [496] [SHIFT: Surface-aware High-speed Integration For TSDFs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06547)
*Ayaan Choudhury,Lokender Tiwari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种高效的实时3D地图构建方法SHIFT，大幅降低了在大型平面环境下的TSDF/ESDF映射计算和存储开销，保持高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时3D地图在机器人导航中尤为关键，尤其是ESDF广泛用于运动规划。当前高精度距离场方法计算量大，且传统方法对已收敛体素重复处理，造成资源浪费。在大平面为主的环境下，这种低效问题更突出。

Method: 提出SHIFT框架，通过直接利用3D深度几何的结构冗余，将局部平坦区域压缩为加权super-rays，并冻结平坦体素梯度，同时设计了紧凑的ESDF体素布局以减少内存开销。

Result: 在多个RGB-D与LiDAR数据集上测试，SHIFT使TSDF计算成本降低1.42到4.07倍，网格误差控制在毫米级，并使ESDF层的内存使用最多减少28%。

Conclusion: SHIFT有效提升了实时3D映射效率和存储性，适用于依赖高质量地图的机器人导航与运动规划场景，兼顾高精度和资源节省。

Abstract: Real-time 3D mapping is fundamental for autonomous robotic navigation, with Euclidean Signed Distance Fields (ESDFs) serving as the standard representation for online motion planning. While recent advancements in non- projective distance fields yield highly accurate maps, their computational overhead remains a severe bottleneck. Conventional integrators redundantly re-fuse millions of depth pixels every frame, even long after the corresponding voxels have converged, wasting significant computational resources in environments dominated by large planar surfaces. In this paper, we present SHIFT (Surface-aware High-speed Integration For TSDFs), an efficient mapping framework designed to reduce this per-frame update cost. By exploiting structural redundancy directly from 3D depth geometry, SHIFT compresses flat local regions into weighted super-rays and freezes flat-voxel gradients. A compact ESDF voxel layout further reduces the memory footprint of the remaining wavefront. Extensive evaluations across various RGB-D and LiDAR sequences show that SHIFT cuts TSDF cost by 1.42 to 4.07 times, while holding mesh error within millimeters, and reduces ESDF-layer memory by up to 28%

</details>


### [497] [Unifying Physics-Based Humanoid Interaction with a Context-Conditioned Interaction Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06591)
*Jianan Li,Xiao Chen,Tien-Tsin Wong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了CHIP框架，一种统一的人形机器人基于物理的技能学习方法，实现了在复杂三维场景下的人形机器人的通用导航与物体操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常只针对运动（locomotion）或物体操控（manipulation）中的某一项专门设计，并且依赖大量的任务特定奖励工程，难以泛化和复用。如何高效地学习可复用、通用的人形机器人技能，仍是难题。

Method: CHIP框架的核心是有条件的交互先验，将异构数据中的技能映射到共享的离散空间，三阶段训练：先通过模仿学习从多样的交互数据中获得基于物理的教师行为，再蒸馏为上下文条件的交互先验，最后结合先验，通过正则化的在线强化学习适应下游任务。

Result: 在多种人形机器人交互任务（包括场景认知导航、复杂操控、组合技能等）中，CHIP能够实现自然流畅且物理合理的动作，支持不同技能的顺畅切换与组合。

Conclusion: CHIP框架能够统一学习并复用人形机器人交互技能，提升了机器人在复杂环境下的任务适应能力和动作多样性，具有较强的通用性与实用前景。

Abstract: Developing unified physics-based humanoid controllers that can navigate complex 3D scenes and manipulate objects remains a longstanding challenge. Existing approaches are often specialized for either locomotion or object-centric manipulation, or rely on task-specific reward engineering that does not scale well across diverse behaviors. We present CHIP, a unified, physics-grounded framework for learning reusable humanoid interaction skills from heterogeneous motion data. Central to our approach is a conditional interaction prior that models a context-dependent distribution over these skills within a shared discrete space. Our method is trained in three stages. We first learn physics-based motion-imitation policies that acquire grounded teacher behaviors from heterogeneous interaction data. We then distill these behaviors into a context-conditioned interaction prior that captures reusable motion structure across locomotion and manipulation. Finally, we initialize downstream task policies from the pretrained prior and adapt them through prior-regularized online RL post-training. Experiments on a diverse suite of humanoid interaction tasks show that our approach supports scene-aware locomotion, contact-rich object manipulation, and compositional behaviors such as environment-aware object transport and long-horizon skill sequencing, while producing smooth transitions and physically plausible motion.

</details>


### [498] [MemCorr-DP: Counterfactual Correspondence Conditioning for a Diffusion Policy Guided by a Reference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06615)
*Tan Su,Haoxiang Yang,Ruxin Wang,Binghui Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新型扩散策略MemCorr-DP，通过显式3D关联方式提升基于视觉的机器人操作泛化能力，在训练分布外的空间和视角变化下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统行为克隆的视觉运动策略在物体位置和摄像头视角同时变化时容易失效。期望实现更强泛化能力的机器人操作，需要能有效对齐参考轨迹与当前场景的空间几何。

Method: 提出MemCorr-DP扩散策略，将RoMa v2生成的匹配提升为当前场景与参考轨迹之间的显式3D关系。创新性地加入了反事实配对目标及混合条件微调，使强化学习策略适应从理想几何到实际对应误差。

Result: 在门控任务空间位置和视角都远离训练集的情况下，MemCorr-DP闭环成功率达96.67%，明显优于同结构视觉Transformer（88.00%）。消融实验显示完整的3D关系为关键。

Conclusion: 在空间与视角同时变化的情况下，显式3D参考关联是实现稳健机器人操作的重要条件，MemCorr-DP方法大幅提高了泛化能力。

Abstract: Behavior-cloned visuomotor policies can remain accurate near their training distribution yet fail when object position and camera viewpoint change together. A successful reference trajectory contains the geometry needed to transfer the same interaction, but the policy must align that geometry with the current scene and remain sensitive to it during denoising. To address these challenges, we present MemCorr-DP, a diffusion policy that lifts frozen RoMa v2 matches into explicit 3D relations between the current scene and the reference trajectory. A counterfactual paired objective assigns opposite behaviors the same physical state and noisy action while retaining reference-specific denoising targets. Mixed-condition fine-tuning then adapts the policy from ground-truth geometry to measured correspondence errors. Our strongest evaluation places the Door in the outermost position bands beyond the training support and changes the query camera by $\pm15^\circ$. Under this combined shift, MemCorr-DP achieves 96.67% closed-loop success, compared with 88.00% for a visual Transformer with the same action architecture. Objective ablations and reference interventions show that behavior responds to the selected reference, while matched controls favor the complete relation set over future motion or centroid geometry alone. These results support explicit 3D reference relations as a robust conditioning interface when spatial and viewpoint changes are compounded in the evaluated task.

</details>


### [499] [CAVEAT: Recurrent Multimodal Diffusion Planning for Mapless Aerial Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06623)
*Steven Visch,Nicolò Botteghi,Antonio Franchi,Barbara Bazzana*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出一种基于扩散模型的无人机（UAV）自主探测路径规划方法CAVEAT，该方法依赖于多模态观测与递归内部状态，而无需部署时维护全局地图，并通过仿真与实际试验进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前许多无人机自主探索算法依赖于全局地图的持续更新，导致计算和存储资源消耗大。作者希望探索是否能仅依赖于多模态传感器信息和固定维度的内部状态实现有效的路径规划，为地图受限或未知环境下的无人机探索提供新方案。

Method: 提出了一种名为CAVEAT的扩散策略（diffusion policy），输入为融合的激光雷达（LiDAR）、视觉和位姿特征，并通过递归内部状态进行更新。模型训练数据来源于基于全局地图的专家（FUELv2）生成的轨迹。推理过程中，采用部分热启动和局部距离场启发式指导。模型在模拟和实机（Elios 3无人机）上进行了对比和探索性实验。

Result: 仿真评估了不同推理机制，并将CAVEAT与专家策略进行比较。实际飞行实验在未知室内环境下实现了部分自主探索与目标视觉伺服功能。

Conclusion: 无需全局地图，仅用局部多模态感知和递归内部状态也能实现高效无人机自主探索和路径点规划，为未来在受限或未知场景下部署无人机自主系统提供了可行性验证。

Abstract: Can exploratory UAV waypoint sequences be generated from multimodal onboard observations and a fixed-dimensional recurrent internal state without maintaining a persistent global map in the deployed policy? We investigate this question through CAVEAT, a diffusion policy conditioned on a recurrent internal state updated from fused LiDAR, visual, and pose features and trained from trajectories generated by the map-based FUELv2 expert. Rolling inference partially warm-starts consecutive predictions, while a temporary local signed distance field provides heuristic obstacle guidance. Simulation results evaluate both inference mechanisms and compare CAVEAT with its demonstration-generating expert. Proof-of-concept experiments on a Flyability Elios 3 demonstrate partial exploration of a previously unseen indoor environment and target-directed visual servoing using a separately trained policy.

</details>


### [500] [SkillX: Unified Multi-Skill Policy Learning for Humanoid Soccer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06718)
*Zhangchen Ye,Enxuan Ruan,Yifei Bao,Runhan Huang,Jiankun Yang,Jiakang Jin,Yixiao Huo,Pengyuan Wang,Yinan Han,Huaxing Huang,Wenhao Cui,Yiming Li,Xiaoyu Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出SkillX框架，实现类人机器人在足球任务中多个原子技能的统一学习与灵活组合，有效提升了多技能协作与实机部署能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类人足球机器人方法多依赖多阶段流水线，难以实现在单一策略下多个技能的协同学习和复合，限制了机器人在复杂运动中的灵活性和实用性。

Method: SkillX采用统一的基于指令的强化学习策略，结合技能特定的对抗运动先验、技能专用的评论器和感知目标的时序编码器，从而支持多个原子技能（如带球、控球、射门）的执行与切换。

Result: 在仿真和真实Noetix E1机器人上的实验显示，SkillX可稳定完成多技能执行，实现长时间技能组合，以及仿真到实机的有效迁移。

Conclusion: SkillX提升了类人足球机器人的技能学习和组合能力，为实现更复杂、实用的多技能智能体提供了新方案。

Abstract: Humanoid soccer is a challenging testbed for dynamic whole-body control, requiring robots to coordinate balance, locomotion, object interaction, and skill switching over long horizons. Existing humanoid sports methods often rely on task-specific multi-stage pipelines, making it difficult to jointly learn and compose multiple object-interactive skills within a single deployable policy. To address this, we present SkillX, a unified reinforcement learning framework that learns and composes multiple atomic soccer skills through a single command-conditioned policy. SkillX integrates three core designs: skill-specific adversarial motion priors, skill-specific critics, and an object-aware temporal encoder, enabling the robot to execute atomic skills and transition among them such as dribbling, trapping, and shooting. Experiments in simulation and on a real Noetix E1 humanoid demonstrate robust multi-skill execution, long-horizon skill composition, and successful sim-to-real deployment.

</details>


### [501] [OCTN: Neural OCT Representations for Robot-Guided Precision Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06810)
*Ravi Prakash,Ryan P. McNabb,Patrick J. Codd,Shan Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了OCTN，一个用于光学相干断层扫描（OCT）体积数据的隐式神经表示方法，可实现连续、可微分且空间上精确的组织强度场，用于加速和优化OCT数据的处理、重建及机器人集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统OCT体积数据离散、各向异性且难以实现高效的几何计算和机器人手术集成，影响其在术中引导等场景下的应用。

Method: OCTN结合体素监督和切片间插值，采用两阶段混合训练方式，在GPU上存储和推理，实现快速空间查询、稠密重建及激光手术路径规划等。

Result: OCTN比传统CPU处理快43倍，能4倍加速采集时间，在多个数据集上重建PSNR>30dB，表面重建精度在10微米以内，训练时间低于10秒。

Conclusion: OCTN实现了高效、高保真、连续的OCT三维重建和空间推理，大大提升了OCT在机器人手术等场景下的工程应用潜力，并已开源数据与代码。

Abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) offers compact, contactless, micron-scale imaging suitable for intraoperative guidance, but native OCT volumes are discretely sampled, anisotropic, and currently inefficient for downstream geometric reasoning and robot integration. We present OCTN (pronounced "octane"), an implicit neural representation framework that converts volumetric OCT scans into a continuous, differentiable, and spatially faithful tissue-intensity field. OCTN uses a two-stage hybrid training strategy that combines supervision from acquired voxels with inter-slice interpolations, preserving B-scan fidelity while improving continuity in sparsely sampled regions. For versatility, we first show that OCTN enables fast volumetric reasoning by storing the learned tissue representation natively on the GPU, supporting intensity-based spatial queries with up to 43x speedup over conventional CPU processing. We then demonstrate OCTN-enabled OCT-guided robotic laser surgery where the continuous tissue representation supports implicit surface discovery and surface-constrained path planning via multiple optimization strategies, including Newton- and SGD-based optimization. Next, OCTN enables reconstruction of dense volumetric structure from sparsely acquired B-scans, while reducing acquisition time by 4x and preserving clinically relevant structures. Across the newly generated Duke TissueOCT dataset and public OCT datasets, OCTN achieves robust, high-fidelity reconstruction with PSNR > 30 dB and training time < 10 s, while preserving surface consistency within 10 $μ$m Chamfer distance relative to baseline reconstruction. The TissueOCT dataset and code are publicly available at raprakashvi.github.io/octn

</details>


### [502] [RoboSense: Leveraging Robotaxi Fleets as Drive-by Sensors for Urban Traffic Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06813)
*Yilin Wang,Yiheng Feng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种通过动态调度robotaxi以提升城市级交通监测的新框架，并在SUMO仿真下验证了该方法能同时提高交通监测和robotaxi出行效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着robotaxi普及，其作为移动传感器有助于突破传统交通监测点难以取得全面时空交通信息的局限。本研究旨在探索如何将robotaxi调度与交通监测任务有机结合，实现更优的交通感知。

Method: 作者提出了基于单元格划分的网络模型，设立了单元级的监测覆盖度指标，并构建了一个混合整数线性规划模型，同时优化robotaxi的出行时间和网络覆盖度，在SUMO环境下进行多市场渗透率（2%、5%、10%）和目标权重的仿真实验。

Result: 实验结果表明，将覆盖度提升纳入调度目标后，能够显著提升交通监测效果，并在合理的目标权重组合下，实现监测性能与robotaxi平均速度的同步提升。

Conclusion: 将robotaxi作为行驶中的传感器并优化其行驶路径，不仅提升了监测精度，也改善了出行效率。这有望激发运营商将其robotaxi fleet用于城市交通感知，实现智能交通系统的双赢。

Abstract: Urban traffic monitoring plays a critical role in safety analysis, congestion management, and incident response. The growing deployment of robotaxis creates a new opportunity for network-level traffic monitoring. Although robotaxis are primarily designed to serve passengers, they can also be leveraged as drive-by sensors to collect traffic data. Compared to conventional infrastructure sensors or probe vehicles, a fleet of robotaxis forms a cooperative perception environment, which can collectively gather spatially and temporally continuous traffic information. This paper proposes a novel dynamic robotaxi routing framework that explicitly incorporates traffic monitoring tasks as an objective. The framework introduces: (1) a cell-based network representation that aligns with sensing capabilities of robotaxis; (2) a cell-level monitoring metric to quantify spatiotemporal robotaxi coverage; and (3) a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation that jointly minimizes time-dependent travel time and maximizes traffic monitoring performance. A 5 by 5 urban grid network is built in SUMO to evaluate the framework under three robotaxi market penetration rates (2%, 5%, and 10%) with a range of objective weight combinations. Results show that incorporating spatiotemporal network coverage in the objective function can effectively improve the traffic monitoring performance. Interestingly, with appropriate weights between the two objectives, monitoring performance and robotaxi average speed can be improved simultaneously. This suggests better network monitoring leads to more accurate traffic state prediction and improved mobility. This win-win situation could incentivize robotaxi operators to contribute their vehicles as drive-by sensors for traffic monitoring.

</details>


### [503] [Diagnosing and Dynamically Filtering Occupancy World Models for Active Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06820)
*Jiahui Zhang,Gongbo Liang,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文分析了不同的3D占据网络表示对机器人主动地图构建和路径规划的影响，发现占据准确度与最终覆盖表现并不完全匹配，并提出了一种动态滤波策略提升可达性和探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动地图构建依赖机器人选择有助于高效重建未知三维场景的视角。既有方法利用预训练占据网络补全未观测区域，但这些模型的错误可能影响探索与可达性。研究旨在揭示占据表示的误差对下游规划和重建性能的影响。

Method: 在保持规划模块不变的前提下，分别采用不同的占据表示（无补全、学习型、去除假阳性、补充假阴性、使用真实占据）进行实验，观测各自对最终覆盖情况的影响。此外，提出并测试了基于在线观测的动态滤波策略，动态调整未被实验证实的占据预测。

Result: 仅修正假阳性或假阴性不能显著提升覆盖率。使用真实占据数据，提升了覆盖效率但对最终覆盖度提升有限，说明占据准确性并不是限制主动探索的唯一因素。动态滤波策略初步结果表明能够更有效引导机器人探索实际可达区域。

Conclusion: 占据网络的精度与主动探索的表现之间存在鸿沟。即使有准确的几何世界模型，规划与可达性仍然是主要瓶颈。动态滤波可一定程度上缓解该问题，引导机器人关注真正可达的未知区域。

Abstract: Active mapping requires a robot to select camera viewpoints that efficiently reconstruct an unknown 3D scene. To reason about unobserved regions, recent systems use pretrained occupancy networks as world models that complete missing geometry. The predicted structure contributes to expected coverage gain and constrains feasible robot motion. Consequently, occupancy errors can change both what the robot chooses to explore and where it is able to move. We diagnose these effects by holding the planner fixed and varying only the occupancy representation provided to it. We consider planning without completion, with learned occupancy, with false positives removed by a ground truth oracle, with false negatives restored by an oracle, and with ground truth occupancy. Our experiments show that correcting false positives or false negatives alone does not consistently improve final coverage. This finding reveals a gap between occupancy accuracy and downstream planning performance. Ground truth occupancy provides a much larger improvement in coverage efficiency than in endpoint coverage, suggesting that planning and reachability remain important bottlenecks even when the geometric world model is accurate. Based on these findings, we introduce a dynamic filtering strategy that preserves predictions in unexplored space while suppressing repeatedly unsupported occupancy using online observations. Preliminary examples show that this strategy can redirect viewpoint selection toward reachable surfaces that would otherwise remain unobserved.

</details>


### [504] [ContextFlow: In-Context Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06852)
*Jian Ding,Xianjie Dai,Roei Herzig,Nussair Hroub,Jinjie Mai,Dengxin Dai,Bernard Ghanem,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的基于flow-matching的机器人上下文仿效学习方法ContextFlow，能更好地泛化到未见过的任务配置并显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的上下文模仿学习方法在机器人控制中受限于对连续动作的离散化和误差累积，导致难以泛化到新任务。此外，在连续动作下的flow-matching框架中的上下文仿效学习尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出ContextFlow，将flow-matching方法引入机器人上下文仿效学习。该方法基于条件流匹配模型，能直接学习连续动作分布。通过Perceiver风格的多模态上下文压缩器，将视觉、运动感知和动作序列编码为紧凑且与任务相关的隐变量表征，提高演示信息的表达能力。

Result: 在LIBERO基准中，ContextFlow在未见过任务上的平均成功率超越ICRT 35个百分点，并达到与专门微调的VLA模型π_0相当的效果（但无需新任务微调）。在真实机器人实验中，对单臂和双臂新型任务也能取得40%的成功率。

Conclusion: ContextFlow突破了现有机器人上下文仿效学习的局限，能更好地泛化到新任务或配置，在仿真与现实环境中均显著优于主流方法，展示了强大的通用性和实用潜力。

Abstract: Although highly effective in vision and language domains, applying in-context learning to robotics remains challenging. Existing autoregressive in-context imitation methods discretize continuous actions and exacerbate the accumulation of early prediction errors through next-token prediction, limiting their generalization on unseen task configurations. Meanwhile, flow-matching policies have been explored for continuous robot control and can help mitigate compounding errors; however, in-context imitation learning within a flow-matching framework remains underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce ContextFlow, a conditional flow-matching model that learns continuous action distributions for in-context imitation learning. ContextFlow conditions flow-based action prediction on demonstrations and observations, enabling robust generation from noisy action distributions. To better encode multimodal in-context demonstrations, we adapt perceiver-style multimodal context compressors that distill visual, proprioceptive, and action sequences into compact, task-relevant latent representations.
